59.s:
bhagavānuvāca
hareḥ sānnidhyakaraṇamadhivāsanamucyate /
sarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ dhyātvā ātmānaṃ puruṣottamaṃ //
59.d:
भगवानुवाच
हरेः सान्निध्यकरणमधिवासनमुच्यते /
सर्वज्ञं सर्वगं ध्यात्वा आत्मानं पुरुषोत्तमं //
59.m: The Holy One said: / Preliminary consecration is defined as effecting the immediate presence of Hari; / having meditated upon the self as omniscient, all-pervading Puruṣottama,

59.s:
oṃkāreṇa samāyojya cicchaktimabhimāninīṃ(1) /
niḥsāryātmaikatāṃ kṛtvā svasmin(2) sarvagate vibhau //
59.d:
ओंकारेण समायोज्य चिच्छक्तिमभिमानिनीं(1) /
निःसार्यात्मैकतां कृत्वा स्वस्मिन्(2) सर्वगते विभौ //
59.m: having joined the consciousness-power that has individuality by means of the syllable Oṃ, / having led it forth and effected unity of the self in one's own all-pervading, omnipresent Lord,

59.s:
yojayenmarutāṃ pṛthvīṃ vahnivījena dīpayet /
saṃharedvāyunā cāgniṃ vāyumākāśato nayet //
:n
1 matiśālinīmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 kṛtvā puṃsīti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 167
59.d:
योजयेन्मरुतां पृथ्वीं वह्निवीजेन दीपयेत् /
संहरेद्वायुना चाग्निं वायुमाकाशतो नयेत् //
:न्
1 मतिशालिनीमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 कृत्वा पुंसीति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 167
59.m:
he should unite earth with the winds; he should kindle it with the fire seed-syllable; / he should dissolve fire with wind, and lead wind into space.
[...]
1 "matiśālinīm" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2 "kṛtvā puṃsi" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 167]

59.s:
adhibhūtādidevaistu sādhyākhyair vibhavaiḥ(1) saha /
tanmātrapātrakān kṛtvā saṃharettat kramād budhaḥ //
59.d:
अधिभूतादिदेवैस्तु साध्याख्यैर् विभवैः(1) सह /
तन्मात्रपात्रकान् कृत्वा संहरेत्तत् क्रमाद् बुधः //
59.m: Along with the elemental and presiding deities, and with the manifestations called Sādhyas, / having made vessels for the subtle elements, the wise one should dissolve them in sequence.

59.s:
ākāśaṃ manasāhatya manohaṅkaraṇe kuru(2) /
ahaṅkārañca mahati tañcāpyavyākṛte nayet //
59.d:
आकाशं मनसाहत्य मनोहङ्करणे कुरु(2) /
अहङ्कारञ्च महति तञ्चाप्यव्याकृते नयेत् //
59.m:
Withdrawing space into the mind, place the mind in the ego;
and lead the ego into the great [intellect], and that into the unmanifest.

59.s:
avyākṛtaṃ jñānarūpe vāsudevaḥ sa īritaḥ(3) /
sa tāmavyākṛtiṃ māyāmabhyaṣṭa sisṛkṣayā //
59.d:
अव्याकृतं ज्ञानरूपे वासुदेवः स ईरितः(3) /
स तामव्याकृतिं मायामभ्यष्ट सिसृक्षया //
59.m:
[Lead] the unmanifest into the form of knowledge; he is declared as Vāsudeva.
With the desire to create, he regarded that unmanifest māyā.

59.s:
saṅkarṣaṇaṃ saṃ śabdātmā sparśākhyamasṛjat prabhuḥ /
kṣobhya māyāṃ sa pradyumnaṃ tejorūpaṃ sa cāsṛjat //
59.d:
सङ्कर्षणं सं शब्दात्मा स्पर्शाख्यमसृजत् प्रभुः /
क्षोभ्य मायां स प्रद्युम्नं तेजोरूपं स चासृजत् //
59.m:
The Lord, consisting of sound, created Saṅkarṣaṇa, named touch;
agitating māyā, he created Pradyumna, consisting of fire [and sight].

59.s:
aniruddhaṃ rasamātraṃ brahmāṇaṃ gandharūpakaṃ /
aniruddhaḥ sa ca brahmā apa ādau sasarja ha //
59.d:
अनिरुद्धं रसमात्रं ब्रह्माणं गन्धरूपकं /
अनिरुद्धः स च ब्रह्मा अप आदौ ससर्ज ह //
59.m:
[He created] Aniruddha, which is subtle taste, and Brahmā, having the form of smell.
That Aniruddha and Brahmā verily created the waters in the beginning.

59.s:
tasmin hiraṇmayañcāṇḍaṃ so 'sṛjat pañcabhūtavat /
tasmin saṅkrāmite jīve(4) śaktirātmopasaṃhṛtā //
59.d:
तस्मिन् हिरण्मयञ्चाण्डं सो ऽसृजत् पञ्चभूतवत् /
तस्मिन् सङ्क्रामिते जीवे(4) शक्तिरात्मोपसंहृता //
59.m:
In that [water], he created the golden egg endowed with the five elements.
When the individual soul was introduced into it, the power [of the Lord] was withdrawn into himself.

59.s:
prāṇo jīvena saṃyukto vṛttimāniti śabdyate /
jīvovyāhṛtisañjñastu prāṇeṣvādhyātmikaḥ smṛtaḥ //
59.d:
प्राणो जीवेन संयुक्तो वृत्तिमानिति शब्द्यते /
जीवोव्याहृतिसञ्ज्ञस्तु प्राणेष्वाध्यात्मिकः स्मृतः //
59.m:
The vital breath, united with the individual soul, is called active;
and the individual soul, designated as the utterance, is regarded as the spiritual principle among the vital breaths.

59.s:
prāṇair yuktā tato buddhiḥ sañjātā cāṣṭamūrtikī(5) /
ahaṅkārastato jajñe manastasmādajāyata //
59.d:
प्राणैर् युक्ता ततो बुद्धिः सञ्जाता चाष्टमूर्तिकी(5) /
अहङ्कारस्ततो जज्ञे मनस्तस्मादजायत //
59.m:
United with the vital breaths, the intellect was then produced, possessing eight forms;
from that, ego was born; from that, the mind arose.

59.s:
arthāḥ prajajñire pañca saṅkalpādiyutāstataḥ /
śabdaḥ sparśaś ca rūpañca raso gandha iti smṛtā //
59.d:
अर्थाः प्रजज्ञिरे पञ्च सङ्कल्पादियुतास्ततः /
शब्दः स्पर्शश् च रूपञ्च रसो गन्ध इति स्मृता //
59.m:
From that, the five objects [of sense] were produced, accompanied by volition and the rest;
they are recorded as sound, touch, form, taste, and smell.

59.s:
jñānaśaktiyutānyetair ārabdhānīndriyāṇi tu /
:n
1 sādhyārthair vibhavair iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
sādhyādyair vibhavair iti ṅa, cihinitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 manasāhṛtya mano 'haṅkaraṇe kṣare iti gha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 vāsudeve samāhita iti ṅa, iti cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 saṅkramate jīva iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 cāṣṭavṛttikīti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 168
tvakśrotraghrāṇacakṣūṃṣi jihvābuddhīndriyāṇi tu //
59.d:
ज्ञानशक्तियुतान्येतैर् आरब्धानीन्द्रियाणि तु /
:न्
1 साध्यार्थैर् विभवैर् इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
साध्याद्यैर् विभवैर् इति ङ, चिहिनितपुस्तकपाठः
2 मनसाहृत्य मनो ऽहङ्करणे क्षरे इति घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 वासुदेवे समाहित इति ङ, इति चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 सङ्क्रमते जीव इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 चाष्टवृत्तिकीति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 168
त्वक्श्रोत्रघ्राणचक्षूंषि जिह्वाबुद्धीन्द्रियाणि तु //
59.m:
Endowed with the power of knowledge, the sense faculties were produced by these:
[Notes]
1 "sādhyārthair vibhavaiḥ" is the reading of manuscripts marked kha and ga.
"sādhyādyair vibhavaiḥ" is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
2 "manasāhṛtya mano 'haṅkaraṇe kṣare" is the reading of the manuscript marked gha.
3 "vāsudeve samāhitaḥ" is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
4 "saṅkramate jīvaḥ" is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
5 "cāṣṭavṛttikī" is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
Page 168
skin, ear, nose, eyes,
and tongue are the cognitive senses.

59.s:
pādau pāyuḥs tathā pāṇī vāgupasthaś ca pañcamaḥ /
karmendriyāṇi caitāni pañcabhūtānyataḥ śṛṇu //
59.d:
पादौ पायुःस् तथा पाणी वागुपस्थश् च पञ्चमः /
कर्मेन्द्रियाणि चैतानि पञ्चभूतान्यतः शृणु //
59.m:
The feet, the anus, likewise the hands,
speech, and the genitals as the fifth—these are the action senses; now hear the five elements:

59.s:
ākāśavāyutejāṃsi salilaṃ pṛthivī tathā /
sthūlamebhiḥ śarīrantu sarvādhāraṃ prajāyate //
59.d:
आकाशवायुतेजांसि सलिलं पृथिवी तथा /
स्थूलमेभिः शरीरन्तु सर्वाधारं प्रजायते //
59.m:
space, wind, fire, water, and earth.
From these the gross body, the receptacle of all, is produced.

59.s:
eteṣāṃ vācakā mantrā nyāsāyocyanta uttamāḥ /
jīvabhūtaṃ makārantu devasya(1) vyāpakaṃ nyaset //
59.d:
एतेषां वाचका मन्त्रा न्यासायोच्यन्त उत्तमाः /
जीवभूतं मकारन्तु देवस्य(1) व्यापकं न्यसेत् //
59.m:
The supreme mantras signifying these are proclaimed for deposition.
One should deposit the syllable 'ma', representing the individual soul, pervading the deity.

59.s:
prāṇatattvaṃ bhakārantu jīvopādhigataṃ nyaset /
hṛdayasthaṃ bakārantu buddhitattvaṃ nyased budhaḥ //
59.d:
प्राणतत्त्वं भकारन्तु जीवोपाधिगतं न्यसेत् /
हृदयस्थं बकारन्तु बुद्धितत्त्वं न्यसेद् बुधः //
59.m:
One should deposit the syllable 'bha', the principle of vital breath residing in the limiting adjunct of the soul;
the wise one should deposit the syllable 'ba', the principle of intellect residing in the heart.

59.s:
phakāramapi tatraiva ahaṅkāramayaṃ nyaset /
manastattvaṃ pakārantu nyasetsaṅkalpasambhavaṃ //
59.d:
फकारमपि तत्रैव अहङ्कारमयं न्यसेत् /
मनस्तत्त्वं पकारन्तु न्यसेत्सङ्कल्पसम्भवं //
59.m:
Right there one should also deposit the syllable 'pha', consisting of the ego;
and one should deposit the syllable 'pa', the principle of mind, born of volition.

59.s:
śabdatanmātratattvantu nakāraṃ mastake nyaset /
sparśātmakaṃ dhakārantu vaktradeśe tu vinyaset //
59.d:
शब्दतन्मात्रतत्त्वन्तु नकारं मस्तके न्यसेत् /
स्पर्शात्मकं धकारन्तु वक्त्रदेशे तु विन्यसेत् //
59.m:
One should deposit the syllable 'na', the principle of the subtle element of sound, on the head;
and one should deposit the syllable 'dha', consisting of touch, in the region of the face.

59.s:
dakāraṃ rūpatattvantu hṛddeśe viniveśayet(2) /
thakāraṃ vastideśe tu rasatanmātrakaṃ nyaset //
59.d:
दकारं रूपतत्त्वन्तु हृद्देशे विनिवेशयेत्(2) /
थकारं वस्तिदेशे तु रसतन्मात्रकं न्यसेत् //
59.m:
One should place the syllable 'da', the principle of form, in the region of the heart;
one should deposit the syllable 'tha', the subtle element of taste, in the region of the bladder.

59.s:
takāraṃ gandhatanmātraṃ jaṅghayorviniveśayet /
ṇakāraṃ śrotrayor nyasya ḍhakāraṃ vinyasettvaci //
59.d:
तकारं गन्धतन्मात्रं जङ्घयोर्विनिवेशयेत् /
णकारं श्रोत्रयोर् न्यस्य ढकारं विन्यसेत्त्वचि //
59.m:
One should place the syllable 'ta', the subtle element of smell, in the two shanks;
having deposited the syllable 'ṇa' in the two ears, one should deposit the syllable 'ḍha' on the skin.

59.s:
ḍakāraṃ netrayugme tu rasanāyāṃ ṭhakārakaṃ /
ṭakāraṃ nāsikāyāntu ñakāraṃ vāci vinyaset //
59.d:
डकारं नेत्रयुग्मे तु रसनायां ठकारकं /
टकारं नासिकायान्तु ञकारं वाचि विन्यसेत् //
59.m:
[One should deposit] the syllable 'ḍa' in the pair of eyes, and the syllable 'ṭha' on the tongue;
one should deposit the syllable 'ṭa' in the nose, and the syllable 'ña' in speech.

59.s:
jhakāraṃ karayor nyasya pāṇitattvaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ /
jakāraṃ padayor nyasya chaṃ pāyau camupasthake //
59.d:
झकारं करयोर् न्यस्य पाणितत्त्वं विचक्षणः /
जकारं पदयोर् न्यस्य छं पायौ चमुपस्थके //
59.m:
The discerning one, having deposited the syllable 'jha', the principle of hands, in the two hands;
having deposited the syllable 'ja' in the two feet, [deposits] 'cha' in the anus and 'ca' in the genitals.

59.s:
vinyaset pṛthivītattvaṃ ṅakāraṃ pādayugmake /
vastau ghakāraṃ gaṃ tattvaṃ taijasaṃ hṛdi vinyaset //
:n
1 makārantaddehasyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 viniyojayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 169
59.d:
विन्यसेत् पृथिवीतत्त्वं ङकारं पादयुग्मके /
वस्तौ घकारं गं तत्त्वं तैजसं हृदि विन्यसेत् //
:न्
1 मकारन्तद्देहस्येति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 विनियोजयेदिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 169
59.m:
One should deposit the syllable 'ṅa', the principle of earth, in the pair of feet;
the syllable 'gha' in the bladder, and the syllable 'ga', the fiery principle, in the heart.
[Notes]
1 "makārantaddehasya" is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
2 "viniyojayet" is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
Page 169

59.s:
khakāraṃ vāyutattvañca nāsikāyāṃ niveśayet /
kakāraṃ vinyasennityaṃ khatattvaṃ mastake budhaḥ //
59.d:
खकारं वायुतत्त्वञ्च नासिकायां निवेशयेत् /
ककारं विन्यसेन्नित्यं खतत्त्वं मस्तके बुधः //
59.m:
One should place the syllable 'kha', the principle of wind, in the nose;
the wise one should always deposit the syllable 'ka', the principle of space, on the head.

59.s:
hṛtpuṇḍarīke vinyasya yakāraṃ sūryadaivataṃ /
dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi hṛdayādabhiniḥsṛtāḥ //
59.d:
हृत्पुण्डरीके विन्यस्य यकारं सूर्यदैवतं /
द्वासप्ततिसहस्राणि हृदयादभिनिःसृताः //
59.m:
Having deposited in the lotus of the heart the syllable 'ya', whose deity is the sun;
seventy-two thousand [channels] go forth from the heart.

59.s:
kalāṣoḍaśasaṃyuktaṃ makāraṃ tatra vinyaset /
tanmadhye cintayenmantrī vinduṃ vahnestu maṇḍalaṃ //
59.d:
कलाषोडशसंयुक्तं मकारं तत्र विन्यसेत् /
तन्मध्ये चिन्तयेन्मन्त्री विन्दुं वह्नेस्तु मण्डलं //
59.m:
One should deposit there the syllable 'ma' endowed with sixteen digits;
in the middle of it the practitioner should contemplate the drop and the orb of fire.

59.s:
hakāraṃ(1) vinyasettatra praṇavena surottamaḥ /
oṃ āṃ parameṣṭhyātmane āṃ namaḥ puruṣātmane //
59.d:
हकारं(1) विन्यसेत्तत्र प्रणवेन सुरोत्तमः /
ओं आं परमेष्ठ्यात्मने आं नमः पुरुषात्मने //
59.m:
The best of gods should deposit there the syllable 'ha' along with the praṇava:
'Oṃ āṃ, salutation to the Parameṣṭhin Self; āṃ, salutation to the Puruṣa Self;

59.s:
oṃ vāṃ manonivṛttyātmane nāñca viśvātmane namaḥ /
oṃ vaṃ namaḥ sarvātmane ity uktāḥ pañca śaktayaḥ(2) //
59.d:
ओं वां मनोनिवृत्त्यात्मने नाञ्च विश्वात्मने नमः /
ओं वं नमः सर्वात्मने इत्य् उक्ताः पञ्च शक्तयः(2) //
59.m:
oṃ vāṃ, salutation to the Self of mental cessation; and nāṃ, salutation to the Universal Self;
oṃ vaṃ, salutation to the All-Self'—these are said to be the five energies.

59.s:
sthāne tu prathamā yojyā dvitīyā āsane matā /
tṛtīyā śayane tadvaccaturthī pānakarmaṇi(3) //
59.d:
स्थाने तु प्रथमा योज्या द्वितीया आसने मता /
तृतीया शयने तद्वच्चतुर्थी पानकर्मणि(3) //
59.m:
The first is to be applied to the site, the second is considered for the seat,
the third likewise for the bed, the fourth in the act of drinking;

59.s:
pratyarcāyāṃ(4) pañcamī syātpañcopaniṣadaḥ smṛtāḥ /
hūṅkāraṃ(5) vinyasenmadhye dhyātvā mantramayaṃ hariṃ //
59.d:
प्रत्यर्चायां(4) पञ्चमी स्यात्पञ्चोपनिषदः स्मृताः /
हूङ्कारं(5) विन्यसेन्मध्ये ध्यात्वा मन्त्रमयं हरिं //
59.m:
the fifth should be in the reflection; they are known as the five Upaniṣads.
Having meditated upon Hari made of mantras, one should deposit the syllable 'hūṃ' in the middle.

59.s:
yāṃ mūrtiṃ sthāpayettasmāt(6) mūlamantraṃ nyasettataḥ /
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya mūlakaṃ //
59.d:
यां मूर्तिं स्थापयेत्तस्मात्(6) मूलमन्त्रं न्यसेत्ततः /
ओं नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय मूलकं //
59.m:
For whichever icon one installs, from that [point] one should then deposit the root mantra;
'Oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya' is the root [mantra].

59.s:
śiroghrāṇalalāṭeṣu mukhakaṇṭhahṛdi kramāt /
bhujayorjaṅghayoraṅghyroḥ keśavaṃ śirasi nyaset //
59.d:
शिरोघ्राणललाटेषु मुखकण्ठहृदि क्रमात् /
भुजयोर्जङ्घयोरङ्घ्य्रोः केशवं शिरसि न्यसेत् //
59.m:
On the head, nose, and forehead, in the mouth, throat, and heart in sequence,
on the two arms, two shanks, and two feet: one should deposit Keśava on the head.

59.s:
nārāyaṇaṃ nyasedvaktre grīvāyāṃ mādhavaṃ nyaset /
:n
1 krūṃkāramiti ṅa, cihnitaopustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ ṣaṃ parameṣṭyātmane yannamaḥ puruṣātmane / laṃ namo
viśvātmane namaḥ // naṃ namaḥ sarvātmane ity uktāḥ
pañcaśaktayaḥ iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 dānakarmaṇi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 abhyarcāyāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 kṣakāramiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
6 yā mūrtiḥ sthāpyate tasyāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 170
govindaṃ bhujayornyasya viṣṇuṃ ca hṛdaye nyaset //
59.d:
नारायणं न्यसेद्वक्त्रे ग्रीवायां माधवं न्यसेत् /
:न्
1 क्रूंकारमिति ङ, चिह्नितओपुस्तकपाठः
2 ओं षं परमेष्ट्यात्मने यन्नमः पुरुषात्मने / लं नमो
विश्वात्मने नमः // नं नमः सर्वात्मने इत्य् उक्ताः
पञ्चशक्तयः इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 दानकर्मणि इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 अभ्यर्चायामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 क्षकारमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
6 या मूर्तिः स्थाप्यते तस्यामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 170
गोविन्दं भुजयोर्न्यस्य विष्णुं च हृदये न्यसेत् //
59.m:
One should deposit Nārāyaṇa on the mouth, and Mādhava on the neck;
[Notes]
1 "krūṃkāram" is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
2 "oṃ ṣaṃ parameṣṭyātmane yannamaḥ puruṣātmane / laṃ namo viśvātmane namaḥ // naṃ namaḥ sarvātmane ity uktāḥ pañcaśaktayaḥ" is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
3 "dānakarmaṇi" is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
4 "abhyarcāyām" is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
5 "kṣakāram" is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
6 "yā mūrtiḥ sthāpyate tasyām" is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
Page 170
having deposited Govinda on the two arms, one should deposit Viṣṇu on the heart;

59.s:
madhusūdanakaṃ pṛṣṭhe vāmanaṃ jaṭhare nyaset /
kakṣyāntrivikramaṃ nyasya jaṅghāyāṃ śrīdharaṃ nyaset //
59.d:
मधुसूदनकं पृष्ठे वामनं जठरे न्यसेत् /
कक्ष्यान्त्रिविक्रमं न्यस्य जङ्घायां श्रीधरं न्यसेत् //
59.m:
one should deposit Madhusūdana on the back, and Vāmana on the belly;
having deposited Trivikrama on the sides, one should deposit Śrīdhara on the shank;

59.s:
hṛṣīkeśaṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ padmanābhaṃ tu gulphake /
dāmodaraṃ pādayoś ca hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgakaṃ //
59.d:
हृषीकेशं दक्षिणायां पद्मनाभं तु गुल्फके /
दामोदरं पादयोश् च हृदयादिषडङ्गकं //
59.m:
[one should deposit] Hṛṣīkeśa on the right [shank], and Padmanābha on the ankle;
and Dāmodara on the two feet; and the six limbs, beginning with the heart.

59.s:
etat sādhāraṇaṃ proktamādirmūrtestu sattama /
athavā yasya devasya prārabdhaṃ sthāpanaṃ bhavet //
59.d:
एतत् साधारणं प्रोक्तमादिर्मूर्तेस्तु सत्तम /
अथवा यस्य देवस्य प्रारब्धं स्थापनं भवेत् //
59.m:
This has been declared as common to the primal icon, O best of beings.
Or, for whichever deity the installation has been undertaken,

59.s:
tasyaiva mūlamantreṇa sajīvakaraṇaṃ bhavet /
yasyā mūrtestu yannāma tasyādyaṃ cākṣaraṃ ca yat //
59.d:
तस्यैव मूलमन्त्रेण सजीवकरणं भवेत् /
यस्या मूर्तेस्तु यन्नाम तस्याद्यं चाक्षरं च यत् //
59.m:
the enlivening should be done with his own root mantra alone.
Whatever is the name of whichever icon, and whatever is its first syllable,

59.s:
tat svairair dvādaśair bhedya hy aṅgāni parikalpayet /
hṛdayādīni deveśa mūlañca daśamākṣaraṃ //
59.d:
तत् स्वैरैर् द्वादशैर् भेद्य ह्य् अङ्गानि परिकल्पयेत् /
हृदयादीनि देवेश मूलञ्च दशमाक्षरं //
59.m:
inflecting that with the twelve vowels, one should fashion the limbs,
beginning with the heart, O Lord of gods, and the root is the ten-syllable [mantra].

59.s:
yathā deve tathā dehe(1) tattvāni viniyojayet /
cakrābjamaṇdale viṣṇuṃ yajedgandhādinā tathā(2) //
59.d:
यथा देवे तथा देहे(1) तत्त्वानि विनियोजयेत् /
चक्राब्जमण्दले विष्णुं यजेद्गन्धादिना तथा(2) //
59.m:
Just as in the deity, so in the body should one assign the principles.
One should worship Viṣṇu in the maṇḍala of the disc and lotus with perfumes and the like in that way.

59.s:
pūrvavaccāsanaṃ dhyāyetsagātraṃ(3) saparicchadaṃ /
śubhañcakraṃ dvādaśāraṃ hy upariṣṭādvicintayet //
59.d:
पूर्ववच्चासनं ध्यायेत्सगात्रं(3) सपरिच्छदं /
शुभञ्चक्रं द्वादशारं ह्य् उपरिष्टाद्विचिन्तयेत् //
59.m:
One should meditate on the seat as before, with its parts and with its accoutrements,
and one should visualize the auspicious twelve-spoked wheel above.

59.s:
trinābhicakraṃ dvinemi svaraistacca samanvitaṃ /
pṛṣṭhadeśe tataḥ prājñaḥ prakṛtyādīnniveśayet //
59.d:
त्रिनाभिचक्रं द्विनेमि स्वरैस्तच्च समन्वितं /
पृष्ठदेशे ततः प्राज्ञः प्रकृत्यादीन्निवेशयेत् //
59.m:
It is a wheel with three navels and two fellys, joined with the vowels.
Then on the back part the wise one should install Prakṛti and the rest;

59.s:
pūjayedārakāgreṣu(4) sūryaṃ dvādaśadhā punaḥ /
:n
1 yathā tattve tathā dehe iti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 yajed gandhādinā tata iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / yajedāhutibhis
tathā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 dhyāyet tanmātramiti ga, cihhnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / dhyāyet samātramiti
kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 pūjayed dvādaśāgreṣu iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / pūjayed
dvādaśāreṣu iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 171
kalāṣoḍaśasaṃyuktaṃ somantatra vicintayet //
59.d:
पूजयेदारकाग्रेषु(4) सूर्यं द्वादशधा पुनः /
:न्
1 यथा तत्त्वे तथा देहे इति ख, ग, घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 यजेद् गन्धादिना तत इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / यजेदाहुतिभिस्
तथा इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 ध्यायेत् तन्मात्रमिति ग, चिह्ह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ध्यायेत् समात्रमिति
ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 पूजयेद् द्वादशाग्रेषु इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / पूजयेद्
द्वादशारेषु इति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 171
कलाषोडशसंयुक्तं सोमन्तत्र विचिन्तयेत् //
59.m:
one should worship Sūrya again twelvefold at the ends of the spokes.
[Notes]
1 Reading in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, and ṅa: yathā tattve tathā dehe
2 Reading in manuscript kha: yajed gandhādinā tata; reading in manuscript ga: yajedāhutibhis tathā
3 Reading in manuscript ga: dhyāyet tanmātramiti; reading in manuscript kha: dhyāyet samātramiti
4 Reading in manuscript kha: pūjayed dvādaśāgreṣu; reading in manuscript gha: pūjayed dvādaśāreṣu / :p 171
He should meditate there upon the moon endowed with sixteen digits.

59.s:
sabalaṃ tritayaṃ nābhau cintayeddeśikottamaḥ /
padmañca dvādaśadalaṃ padmamadhye vicintayet //
59.d:
सबलं त्रितयं नाभौ चिन्तयेद्देशिकोत्तमः /
पद्मञ्च द्वादशदलं पद्ममध्ये विचिन्तयेत् //
59.m: The excellent preceptor should meditate on the triad together with Bala at the navel; / and in the center of the lotus, he should meditate on a twelve-petalled lotus.

59.s:
tanmadhye pauruṣīṃ śaktiṃ dhyātvābhyarcya ca diśikaḥ(1) /
pratimāyāṃ hariṃ nyasya tatra taṃ pūjayet surān(2) //
59.d:
तन्मध्ये पौरुषीं शक्तिं ध्यात्वाभ्यर्च्य च दिशिकः(1) /
प्रतिमायां हरिं न्यस्य तत्र तं पूजयेत् सुरान्(2) //
59.m: Having meditated on and worshipped the power of the Puruṣa in its center, the preceptor / should deposit Hari upon the image and worship the gods there.

59.s:
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ samyak sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ kramāt /
dvādaśākṣaravījaistu keśavādīn samarcayet //
59.d:
गन्धपुष्पादिभिः सम्यक् साङ्गं सावरणं क्रमात् /
द्वादशाक्षरवीजैस्तु केशवादीन् समर्चयेत् //
59.m: Properly, with perfumes, flowers, and the rest, in due order, together with [his] limbs and retinue, / he should worship Keśava and the others using the seed-syllables of the twelve-syllabled mantra.

59.s:
dvādaśāre maṇḍale tu laukapālādikaṃ kramāt /
pratimāmarcayet paścādgandhapuṣpādibhirdvijaḥ //
59.d:
द्वादशारे मण्डले तु लौकपालादिकं क्रमात् /
प्रतिमामर्चयेत् पश्चाद्गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्द्विजः //
59.m: Then, on a twelve-spoked maṇḍala, the twice-born should worship the world-protectors and others in order; / afterwards, he should worship the image with perfumes, flowers, and the rest.

59.s:
pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena śriyāḥ sūktena piṇḍikāṃ /
jananādikramāt paścājjanayedvaiṣṇavānalaṃ //
59.d:
पौरुषेण तु सूक्तेन श्रियाः सूक्तेन पिण्डिकां /
जननादिक्रमात् पश्चाज्जनयेद्वैष्णवानलं //
59.m: With the Puruṣasūkta [he should worship the image], and with the hymn to Śrī, the pedestal. / Then, through the sequence of birth and subsequent rites, he should generate the fire of Viṣṇu.

59.s:
hutvāgniṃ hutamiti kuṇḍegniṃ praṇayedbudhaḥ /
agnipraṇayane mantrastvamagne hy agnirucyate //
59.d:
हुत्वाग्निं हुतमिति कुण्डेग्निं प्रणयेद्बुधः /
अग्निप्रणयने मन्त्रस्त्वमग्ने ह्य् अग्निरुच्यते //
59.m: Having offered into the fire, the wise one should lead the fire into the fire-pit with [the mantra] "Hutam"; / in leading the fire, the mantra "Tvam agne hy agnir" is pronounced.

59.s:
dakṣiṇegniṃ hutamiti kuṇḍegniṃ praṇayedbudhaḥ /
agnimagnīti pūrve tu kuṇḍegniṃ praṇayedbudhaḥ //
59.d:
दक्षिणेग्निं हुतमिति कुण्डेग्निं प्रणयेद्बुधः /
अग्निमग्नीति पूर्वे तु कुण्डेग्निं प्रणयेद्बुधः //
59.m: The wise one should lead the fire into the southern fire-pit with [the mantra] "Hutam"; / the wise one should lead the fire into the eastern fire-pit with [the mantra] "Agnim agniḥ".

59.s:
uttare praṇayedagnimagnimagnī havāmahe /
agnipraṇayane mantrastvamagne hy agnirucyate //
59.d:
उत्तरे प्रणयेदग्निमग्निमग्नी हवामहे /
अग्निप्रणयने मन्त्रस्त्वमग्ने ह्य् अग्निरुच्यते //
59.m: He should lead the fire into the north with [the mantra] "Agnim agniṃ havāmahe"; / in leading the fire, the mantra "Tvam agne hy agnir" is pronounced.

59.s:
palāśasamidhānāntu aṣṭottarasahasrakaṃ /
kuṇḍe kuṇḍe homayecca vrīhīn vedādikais tathā //
59.d:
पलाशसमिधानान्तु अष्टोत्तरसहस्रकं /
कुण्डे कुण्डे होमयेच्च व्रीहीन् वेदादिकैस् तथा //
59.m: One should offer one thousand and eight fuel-sticks of palāśa wood, / and likewise grains of rice into each fire-pit with Vedic [verses] and the like.

59.s:
sājyāṃstilān vyāhṛtibhirmūlamantreṇa vai ghṛtaṃ /
kuryāttataḥ śāntihomaṃ madhuratritayena ca //
59.d:
साज्यांस्तिलान् व्याहृतिभिर्मूलमन्त्रेण वै घृतं /
कुर्यात्ततः शान्तिहोमं मधुरत्रितयेन च //
59.m: Sesame seeds mixed with clarified butter [should be offered] with the vyāhṛtis, and clarified butter with the primary mantra; / then he should perform the pacification fire oblation with the three sweets.

59.s:
dvādaśārṇaiḥ spṛśet pādau nābhiṃ hṛn mastakaṃ tataḥ /
ghṛtaṃ dadhi payo hutvā spṛśenmūrdhanyatho tataḥ //
:n
1 dhyātvā paścāttu deśika iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 tatra tān pūjayet surāmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 172
59.d:
द्वादशार्णैः स्पृशेत् पादौ नाभिं हृन् मस्तकं ततः /
घृतं दधि पयो हुत्वा स्पृशेन्मूर्धन्यथो ततः //
:न्
1 ध्यात्वा पश्चात्तु देशिक इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 तत्र तान् पूजयेत् सुरामिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 172
59.m:
With the twelve-syllabled [mantra] he should touch the feet, the navel, the heart, then the head; / having offered clarified butter, curds, and milk, he should then touch [the image] on the head.
[...]
1 Reading in manuscript ṅa: dhyātvā paścāttu deśika
2 Reading in manuscript ga: tatra tān pūjayet surām / :p 172

59.s:
spṛṣṭvā śironābhipādāṃś catasraḥ sthāpayennadīḥ(1) /
gaṅgā ca yamunā godā kramānnāmnā sarasvatī //
59.d:
स्पृष्ट्वा शिरोनाभिपादांश् चतस्रः स्थापयेन्नदीः(1) /
गङ्गा च यमुना गोदा क्रमान्नाम्ना सरस्वती //
59.m: Having touched the head, navel, and feet, he should install the four rivers: / Gaṅgā, Yamunā, Godāvarī, and Sarasvatī, in that order, by name.

59.s:
dahettu viṣṇugāyatryā gāyatryā śrapayeccaruṃ /
homayecca baliṃ dadyāduttare bhojayeddvijān //
59.d:
दहेत्तु विष्णुगायत्र्या गायत्र्या श्रपयेच्चरुं /
होमयेच्च बलिं दद्यादुत्तरे भोजयेद्द्विजान् //
59.m: He should consume [defects] with the Viṣṇugāyatrī, and cook the sacrificial rice with the Gāyatrī; / he should make fire oblations, give food offerings, and feed the twice-born in the north.

59.s:
sāmādhipānāṃ tuṣṭyarthaṃ hemagāṃ gurave dadet /
dikpatibhyo baliṃ dattvā rātrau kuryācca jāgaraṃ /
brahmagītādiśabdena sarvabhāgadhivāsanāt //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye adhivāsanaṃ nāma ūnaṣaṣṭitamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha ṣaṣṭitamodhyāyaḥ
vāsudevapratiṣṭhādividhiḥ
59.d:
सामाधिपानां तुष्ट्यर्थं हेमगां गुरवे ददेत् /
दिक्पतिभ्यो बलिं दत्त्वा रात्रौ कुर्याच्च जागरं /
ब्रह्मगीतादिशब्देन सर्वभागधिवासनात् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये अधिवासनं नाम ऊनषष्टितमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ षष्टितमोध्यायः
वासुदेवप्रतिष्ठादिविधिः
59.m:
To please the lords of the Sāmans, he should give a golden cow to the guru; / having given food offerings to the guardians of the directions, he should keep a night vigil / with the sound of Brahmā hymns and the like, since all portions undergo preliminary consecration.
Thus ends the fifty-ninth chapter, entitled "Preliminary Consecration", in the glorious and primordial Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now the sixtieth chapter.
Rules for the consecration of Vāsudeva and other rites.

60.s:
bhagavānuvāca
piṇḍikāsthāpanārthantu garbhāgāraṃ tu saptadhā /
vibhajed brahmabhāge tu pratimāṃ sthāpayed budhaḥ //
60.d:
भगवानुवाच
पिण्डिकास्थापनार्थन्तु गर्भागारं तु सप्तधा /
विभजेद् ब्रह्मभागे तु प्रतिमां स्थापयेद् बुधः //
60.m: The Lord said: / For the installation of the pedestal, the wise one should divide the inner sanctum into seven parts; / he should install the image in the portion of Brahmā.

60.s:
devamanuṣapaiśācabhāgeṣu na kadācana /
brahmabhāgaṃ parityajya kiñcidāśritya cāṇḍaja //
60.d:
देवमनुषपैशाचभागेषु न कदाचन /
ब्रह्मभागं परित्यज्य किञ्चिदाश्रित्य चाण्डज //
60.m: Never [should it be installed] in the portions of the gods, humans, or piśācas; / O bird-born one, abandoning the portion of Brahmā [entirely], or leaning slightly [toward it],

60.s:
devamānuṣabhāgābhyāṃ sthāpyā yatnāttu piṇḍikā(3) /
napuṃsakakaśilāyāntu ratnanyāsaṃ samācaret //
60.d:
देवमानुषभागाभ्यां स्थाप्या यत्नात्तु पिण्डिका(3) /
नपुंसककशिलायान्तु रत्नन्यासं समाचरेत् //
60.m: the pedestal should be installed with effort within the portions of the gods and humans; / on a neuter stone, one should perform the deposition of precious gems.

60.s:
nārasiṃhena hutvā ratnanyāsaṃ(4) ca tena vai /
:n
1 catasraḥ sthāpayecca gā iti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapaṭhaḥ
2 ghoṣayecca tato makhe iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 sthāpayedāśu piṇḍikāmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 varṇanyāsamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 173
vrīhīn ratnāṃstridhātūṃś ca lohādīṃś candanādikān //
60.d:
नारसिंहेन हुत्वा रत्नन्यासं(4) च तेन वै /
:न्
1 चतस्रः स्थापयेच्च गा इति ग, घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपठः
2 घोषयेच्च ततो मखे इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 स्थापयेदाशु पिण्डिकामिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 वर्णन्यासमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 173
व्रीहीन् रत्नांस्त्रिधातूंश् च लोहादींश् चन्दनादिकान् //
60.m:
Having made fire oblations with the Nṛsiṃha [mantra], [one performs] the deposition of gems with that very [mantra].
[...]
1 Reading in the three manuscripts ga, gha, and ṅa: catasraḥ sthāpayecca gāḥ
2 Reading in manuscript ga: ghoṣayecca tato makhe
3 Reading in manuscript ṅa: sthāpayedāśu piṇḍikām
4 Reading in manuscript ga: varṇanyāsam / :p 173
Grains of rice, gems, three metals, iron and other [minerals], sandalwood, and the like,

60.s:
pūrvādinavagarteṣu nyasen madhye yathāruci /
atha cendrādimantraiś ca garto guggulunāvṛtaḥ //
60.d:
पूर्वादिनवगर्तेषु न्यसेन् मध्ये यथारुचि /
अथ चेन्द्रादिमन्त्रैश् च गर्तो गुग्गुलुनावृतः //
60.m: he should deposit in the nine pits beginning with the east, and in the center according to desire; / then, with the mantras of Indra and the others, the pit is covered with bdellium resin.

60.s:
ratnanyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā pratimāmālabhedguruḥ /
saśalākair darbhapuñjaiś ca sahadevaiḥ samanvitaiḥ //
60.d:
रत्नन्यासविधिं कृत्वा प्रतिमामालभेद्गुरुः /
सशलाकैर् दर्भपुञ्जैश् च सहदेवैः समन्वितैः //
60.m: Having performed the rite of depositing gems, the guru should touch the image / with bundles of darbha grass containing splints, combined with sahadevā plants.

60.s:
savāhyantaiś ca saṃskṛtya pañcagavyena śodhayet /
prokṣayeddarbhatoyena(1) nadītīrthodakena ca //
60.d:
सवाह्यन्तैश् च संस्कृत्य पञ्चगव्येन शोधयेत् /
प्रोक्षयेद्दर्भतोयेन(1) नदीतीर्थोदकेन च //
60.m: Having consecrated [it] with the exterior rites, he should purify it with the five products of the cow; / he should sprinkle it with darbha water and with water from river tirthas.

60.s:
homārthe khaṇḍilaṃ kuryāt sikatābhiḥ samantataḥ /
sārdhahastapramāṇaṃ tu caturasraṃ suśobhanaṃ //
60.d:
होमार्थे खण्डिलं कुर्यात् सिकताभिः समन्ततः /
सार्धहस्तप्रमाणं तु चतुरस्रं सुशोभनं //
60.m: For the sake of the fire oblation, he should make an altar all around with sand, / measuring one and a half cubits, square and very beautiful.

60.s:
aṣṭadikṣu yathānyāsaṃ kalaśānapi vinyaset /
pūrvādyānaṣṭavarṇena agnimānīya saṃskṛtaṃ //
60.d:
अष्टदिक्षु यथान्यासं कलशानपि विन्यसेत् /
पूर्वाद्यानष्टवर्णेन अग्निमानीय संस्कृतं //
60.m: He should also arrange pitchers in the eight directions according to their deposition; / having brought the consecrated fire with the eight-syllabled [mantra] into the [directions] beginning with the east,

60.s:
tvamagnedyubhiriti gāyatryā samidho hunet /
aṣṭārṇenāṣṭaśatakaṃ(2) ājyaṃ pūrṇāṃ pradāpayet //
60.d:
त्वमग्नेद्युभिरिति गायत्र्या समिधो हुनेत् /
अष्टार्णेनाष्टशतकं(2) आज्यं पूर्णां प्रदापयेत् //
60.m: he should offer fuel-sticks with the Gāyatrī [beginning with] "Tvam agne dyubhir"; / with the eight-syllabled [mantra] he should offer one hundred and eight oblations of clarified butter and cause the full oblation to be given.

60.s:
śāntyudakaṃ āmrapatraiḥ(3) mūlena śatamantritaṃ /
siñceddevasya tanmūrdhni śrīś ca te hy anayā ṛcā //
60.d:
शान्त्युदकं आम्रपत्रैः(3) मूलेन शतमन्त्रितं /
सिञ्चेद्देवस्य तन्मूर्ध्नि श्रीश् च ते ह्य् अनया ऋचा //
60.m: Water for pacification consecrated one hundred times with the primary mantra through mango leaves / he should sprinkle upon the head of the deity with this verse: "Śrīś ca te".

60.s:
brahmayānena(4) coddhṛtya uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate /
tadviṣṇoriti mantreṇa prāsādābhimukhaṃ nayet //
60.d:
ब्रह्मयानेन(4) चोद्धृत्य उत्तिष्ठ ब्रह्मणस्पते /
तद्विष्णोरिति मन्त्रेण प्रासादाभिमुखं नयेत् //
60.m: Lifting [it] with the Brahma-vehicle, with the mantra "Uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate" / [and] "Tad viṣṇoḥ", he should bring it facing the temple.

60.s:
śivikāyāṃ hariṃ sthāpya bhrāmayīta purādikaṃ /
gītavedādiśabdaiś ca(5) prāsādadvāri dhārayet //
:n
1 prokṣayed gandhatoyeneti kha, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
2 aṣṭāntenāṣṭaśatakamiti kha, gha,
cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
3 śāntyudakamājyapātrair iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 brahmapātreṇeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 gītavādyādiśabdaiś ca iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 174
60.d:
शिविकायां हरिं स्थाप्य भ्रामयीत पुरादिकं /
गीतवेदादिशब्दैश् च(5) प्रासादद्वारि धारयेत् //
:न्
1 प्रोक्षयेद् गन्धतोयेनेति ख, घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
2 अष्टान्तेनाष्टशतकमिति ख, घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
3 शान्त्युदकमाज्यपात्रैर् इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 ब्रह्मपात्रेणेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 गीतवाद्यादिशब्दैश् च इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 174
60.m:
Placing Hari upon a palanquin, he should carry him around the city and other places; / and with the sounds of songs, the Vedas, and the like, he should hold him at the temple gate.
[...]
1 Reading in the three manuscripts kha, gha, and ṅa: prokṣayed gandhatoyena
2 Reading in the two manuscripts kha and gha: aṣṭāntenāṣṭaśatakam
3 Reading in manuscript kha: śāntyudakamājyapātrair
4 Reading in manuscript ṅa: brahmapātreṇa
5 Reading in manuscript ṅa: gītavādyādiśabdaiś ca / :p 174

60.s:
strībhirviprair maṅgalāṣṭaghaṭaiḥ(1) saṃsnāpayeddhariṃ /
tato gandhādinābhyarcya mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥ //
60.d:
स्त्रीभिर्विप्रैर् मङ्गलाष्टघटैः(1) संस्नापयेद्धरिं /
ततो गन्धादिनाभ्यर्च्य मूलमन्त्रेण देशिकः //
60.m: He should have Hari bathed by women and brāhmaṇas with the eight auspicious water-pots; / then, having worshipped him with perfumes and other offerings using the primary mantra, the preceptor,

60.s:
ato deveti vastrādyamaṣṭāṅgārghyaṃ nivedya ca /
sthire lagne piṇḍikāyāṃ devasya tveti dhārayet //
60.d:
अतो देवेति वस्त्राद्यमष्टाङ्गार्घ्यं निवेद्य च /
स्थिरे लग्ने पिण्डिकायां देवस्य त्वेति धारयेत् //
60.m: offering clothing and other gifts and the eightfold arghya with the mantra "Ato devā", / should set [the image] upon the pedestal during an auspicious astrological moment with "Devasya tvā".

60.s:
oṃ trailokyavikrāntāya namastestu trivikrama /
saṃsthyāpya piṇḍikāyāntu sthiraṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ //
60.d:
ओं त्रैलोक्यविक्रान्ताय नमस्तेस्तु त्रिविक्रम /
संस्थ्याप्य पिण्डिकायान्तु स्थिरं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः //
60.m: "Oṃ, homage be to you who strode across the three worlds, O Trivikrama!"; / having set [the image] on the pedestal, the wise one should make it firm

60.s:
dhruvā dyauriti mantreṇa viśvataś cakṣurityapi /
pañcagavyena saṃsnāpya kṣālya gandhadakena ca //
60.d:
ध्रुवा द्यौरिति मन्त्रेण विश्वतश् चक्षुरित्यपि /
पञ्चगव्येन संस्नाप्य क्षाल्य गन्धदकेन च //
60.m: with the mantra "Dhruvā dyauḥ" and also "Viśvataścakṣuḥ"; / having bathed it with the five products of the cow and washed it with fragrant water,

60.s:
pūjayet sakalīkṛtya sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ hariṃ /
dhyāyet svaṃ tasya mūrtintu pṛthivī tasya pīṭhikā //
60.d:
पूजयेत् सकलीकृत्य साङ्गं सावरणं हरिं /
ध्यायेत् स्वं तस्य मूर्तिन्तु पृथिवी तस्य पीठिका //
60.m: having endowed Hari with all parts, he should worship him along with his limbs and retinue; / he should meditate upon his icon: the earth is his pedestal.

60.s:
kalpayedvigrahaṃ tasya taijasaiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ /
jīvamāvāhayiṣyāmi pañcaviṃśatitattvagaṃ //
60.d:
कल्पयेद्विग्रहं तस्य तैजसैः परमाणुभिः /
जीवमावाहयिष्यामि पञ्चविंशतितत्त्वगं //
60.m: One should fashion his form out of fiery subtle atoms; / [saying:] "I shall summon the soul residing in the twenty-five principles,

60.s:
caitanyaṃ paramānandaṃ jāgratsvapnavivarjitaṃ /
dehendriyamanobuddhiprāṇāhaṅkāravarjitaṃ //
60.d:
चैतन्यं परमानन्दं जाग्रत्स्वप्नविवर्जितं /
देहेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिप्राणाहङ्कारवर्जितं //
60.m: consciousness, supreme bliss, free from waking and dreaming, / devoid of body, sense organs, mind, intellect, vital breath, and ego,

60.s:
brahmādistambaparyantaṃ hṛdayeṣu vyavasthitaṃ /
hṛdayāt pratimāvimbe sthiro bhava pareśvara //
60.d:
ब्रह्मादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तं हृदयेषु व्यवस्थितं /
हृदयात् प्रतिमाविम्बे स्थिरो भव परेश्वर //
60.m: dwelling in the hearts [of beings] from Brahmā down to a clump of grass: / from the heart, O supreme Lord, become steadfast in the image."

60.s:
sajīvaṃ kuru bimbaṃ tvaṃ savāhyābhyantarasthitaḥ /
aṅguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣo dehopādhiṣu saṃsthitaḥ //
60.d:
सजीवं कुरु बिम्बं त्वं सवाह्याभ्यन्तरस्थितः /
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रः पुरुषो देहोपाधिषु संस्थितः //
60.m: "Abiding both outside and within, make this image ensouled; / the person of the measure of a thumb, abiding in the bodily limiting adjuncts,

60.s:
jyotirjñānaṃ paraṃ brahma ekamevādvitīyakaṃ /
sajīvīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā praṇavena nibodhayet //
60.d:
ज्योतिर्ज्ञानं परं ब्रह्म एकमेवाद्वितीयकं /
सजीवीकरणं कृत्वा प्रणवेन निबोधयेत् //
60.m: radiant light, consciousness, supreme Brahman, one alone without a second." / Having performed the ensouling, one should awaken [him] with the praṇava.

60.s:
sānnidhyakaraṇannāma hṛdayaṃ spṛśya vai japet /
sūktantu pauruṣaṃ dhyāyan idaṃ guhyamanuṃ japet //
60.d:
सान्निध्यकरणन्नाम हृदयं स्पृश्य वै जपेत् /
सूक्तन्तु पौरुषं ध्यायन् इदं गुह्यमनुं जपेत् //
60.m: Touching the heart, one should indeed recite the bringing about of divine presence; / contemplating the Puruṣa-hymn, one should recite this secret mantra:

60.s:
namastestu sureśāya santoṣavibhavātmane /
:n
1 maṅgalāṣṭaghaṭe iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 175
jñānavijñānarūpāya brahmatejonuyāyine //
60.d:
नमस्तेस्तु सुरेशाय सन्तोषविभवात्मने /
:न्
1 मङ्गलाष्टघटे इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 175
ज्ञानविज्ञानरूपाय ब्रह्मतेजोनुयायिने //
60.m:
"Praise be to you, Lord of the gods, whose self is the power of contentment,
[...]
1. "maṅgalāṣṭaghaṭe" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ga.
whose nature is wisdom and knowledge, who follow the splendour of Brahman,

60.s:
guṇātikrāntaveśāya(1) puruṣāya mahātmane /
akṣayāya purāṇāya viṣṇo sannihito bhava //
60.d:
गुणातिक्रान्तवेशाय(1) पुरुषाय महात्मने /
अक्षयाय पुराणाय विष्णो सन्निहितो भव //
60.m: whose form transcends the qualities, the supreme Soul, the Person, / the imperishable, the ancient: O Viṣṇu, be present here!

60.s:
yacca te paramaṃ tattvaṃ(2) yacca jñānamayaṃ vapuḥ /
tat sarvamekato līnamasmindehe vibudhyatāṃ //
60.d:
यच्च ते परमं तत्त्वं(2) यच्च ज्ञानमयं वपुः /
तत् सर्वमेकतो लीनमस्मिन्देहे विबुध्यतां //
60.m: Whatever is your supreme principle, and whatever is your form consisting of knowledge, / let all of that, merged in unity, awaken within this body."

60.s:
ātmānaṃ sannidhīkṛtya brahmādiparivārakān /
svanāmnā sthāpayedanyānāyudhān svamudrayā //
60.d:
आत्मानं सन्निधीकृत्य ब्रह्मादिपरिवारकान् /
स्वनाम्ना स्थापयेदन्यानायुधान् स्वमुद्रया //
60.m: Having brought about the presence of the Self, one should install the retinue beginning with Brahmā / each with their own name, and the other weapons with their own ritual gesture.

60.s:
yātrāvarṣādikaṃ dṛṣṭvā(3) jñeyaḥ sannihito hariḥ /
natvā stutvā stavādyaiś ca japtvā cāṣṭākṣarādikaṃ //
60.d:
यात्रावर्षादिकं दृष्ट्वा(3) ज्ञेयः सन्निहितो हरिः /
नत्वा स्तुत्वा स्तवाद्यैश् च जप्त्वा चाष्टाक्षरादिकं //
60.m: Observing the festive procession, rain, and the like, Hari is known to be present. / Having bowed and praised [him] with hymns and other prayers, and having recited the eight-syllabled [mantra] and others,

60.s:
caṇḍapracaṇḍau dvārasthau nirgatyābhyarcayedguruḥ /
agnimaṇḍapamāsādya garuḍaṃ sthāpya pūjayet //
60.d:
चण्डप्रचण्डौ द्वारस्थौ निर्गत्याभ्यर्चयेद्गुरुः /
अग्निमण्डपमासाद्य गरुडं स्थाप्य पूजयेत् //
60.m: the guru should go out and worship Caṇḍa and Pracaṇḍa stationed at the door. / Having approached the fire pavilion, he should install and worship Garuḍa.

60.s:
digīśān diśi devāṃś ca sthāpya sampūjya deśikaḥ /
viśvaksenaṃ tu saṃsthāpya śaṅkhacakrādi pūjayet //
60.d:
दिगीशान् दिशि देवांश् च स्थाप्य सम्पूज्य देशिकः /
विश्वक्सेनं तु संस्थाप्य शङ्खचक्रादि पूजयेत् //
60.m: Having installed and thoroughly worshipped the regents of the quarters and the gods in each direction, the preceptor / should then install Viṣvaksena and worship the conch, discus, and other [attributes].

60.s:
sarvapārṣadakebhyaś ca baliṃ bhūtebhya arcayet /
paramavastrasuvarṇādi gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadet //
60.d:
सर्वपार्षदकेभ्यश् च बलिं भूतेभ्य अर्चयेत् /
परमवस्त्रसुवर्णादि गुरवे दक्षिणां ददेत् //
60.m: One should also offer an oblation to all the attendants and spirits; / one should give excellent garments, gold, and other gifts as a sacrificial fee to the guru.

60.s:
yāgopayogidravyādyamācāryāya narorpayet /
ācāryadakṣiṇārdhantu ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadet //
60.d:
यागोपयोगिद्रव्याद्यमाचार्याय नरोर्पयेत् /
आचार्यदक्षिणार्धन्तु ऋत्विग्भ्यो दक्षिणां ददेत् //
60.m: A man should present to the ācārya the articles and materials used in the sacrifice; / he should give a sacrificial fee to the officiating priests equal to half the sacrificial fee of the ācārya.

60.s:
anyebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādbhojayed brāhmaṇāṃstataḥ /
avāritān phalān(4) dadyādyajamānāya vai guruḥ //
60.d:
अन्येभ्यो दक्षिणां दद्याद्भोजयेद् ब्राह्मणांस्ततः /
अवारितान् फलान्(4) दद्याद्यजमानाय वै गुरुः //
60.m: He should give a sacrificial fee to the others and then feed the brāhmaṇas. / The guru should indeed confer unimpeded fruits upon the patron of the sacrifice.

60.s:
viṣṇuṃ nayet pratiṣṭhātā(5) cātmanā sakalaṃ kulaṃ /
:n
1 guṇātikrāntarūpāya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 yacca te paramaṃ guhyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 yātrāvarṣādikaṃ kṛtveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 avāritaphalamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 pratiṣṭhākṛditi kha, ga, gha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ
:p 176
sarveṣāmeva devānāmeṣa sādhāraṇo vidhiḥ /
mūlamantrāḥ pṛthakteṣāṃ śeṣaṃ kāryaṃ samānakaṃ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye vāsudevapratiṣṭhādikathanaṃ nāma
ṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha ekaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
dvārapratiṣṭhādhvajārohāṇādividhiḥ
60.d:
विष्णुं नयेत् प्रतिष्ठाता(5) चात्मना सकलं कुलं /
:न्
1 गुणातिक्रान्तरूपाय इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 यच्च ते परमं गुह्यमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 यात्रावर्षादिकं कृत्वेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 अवारितफलमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 प्रतिष्ठाकृदिति ख, ग, घ, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकचतुष्टयपाठः
:प् 176
सर्वेषामेव देवानामेष साधारणो विधिः /
मूलमन्त्राः पृथक्तेषां शेषं कार्यं समानकं //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये वासुदेवप्रतिष्ठादिकथनं नाम
षष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ एकषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः
द्वारप्रतिष्ठाध्वजारोहाणादिविधिः
60.m:
The consecrator leads Viṣṇu and his own entire family [to highest state].
[...]
1. "guṇātikrāntarūpāya" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "yacca te paramaṃ guhyam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. "yātrāvarṣādikaṃ kṛtvā" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
4. "avāritaphalam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
5. "pratiṣṭhākṛt" is the reading in the four manuscripts marked kha, ga, gha, and ṅa.
This is the general rule for all the deities.
Their root mantras are different; the rest of the procedure is the same.
Thus ends the sixtieth chapter, called "The description of the consecration of Vāsudeva and others", in the venerable Agni Mahāpurāṇa.
Now, sixty-first chapter.
The ritual for consecration of the entrance, raising the flag, and other rites.

61.s:
bhagavānuvāca
vakṣe cāvabhṛtasnānaṃ viṣṇor natveti(1) homayet /
ekāśītipade kumbhān sthāpya saṃsthāpayeddhariṃ //
61.d:
भगवानुवाच
वक्षे चावभृतस्नानं विष्णोर् नत्वेति(1) होमयेत् /
एकाशीतिपदे कुम्भान् स्थाप्य संस्थापयेद्धरिं //
61.m: The Blessed Lord said: / I shall declare the concluding bath of Viṣṇu: one should make offerings with the mantra "Natvā..."; / having placed water pots on the eighty-one-square grid, one should install Hari.

61.s:
pūjayed gandhapuṣpādyair baliṃ datvā guruṃ yajet /
dvārapratiṣṭhāṃ vakṣyāmi dvārādho hema vai dadet //
61.d:
पूजयेद् गन्धपुष्पाद्यैर् बलिं दत्वा गुरुं यजेत् /
द्वारप्रतिष्ठां वक्ष्यामि द्वाराधो हेम वै ददेत् //
61.m: One should worship him with fragrant pastes, flowers, and the like, and having offered an oblation, worship the guru. / I shall explain the consecration of the doorway: one should place gold beneath the doorway.

61.s:
aṣṭabhiḥ kalaśaiḥ sthāpya śākhodumbarakau guruḥ /
gandhādibhiḥ samabhyarcya mantrair vedādibhirguruḥ //
61.d:
अष्टभिः कलशैः स्थाप्य शाखोदुम्बरकौ गुरुः /
गन्धादिभिः समभ्यर्च्य मन्त्रैर् वेदादिभिर्गुरुः //
61.m: Having installed the doorjambs and lintel with eight water pots, the guru, / having worshipped them with fragrant pastes and other items, using Vedic mantras and the like,

61.s:
kuṇḍeṣu homayedvahniṃ samillājatilādibhiḥ /
datvā śayyādikañcādho dadyādādhāraśaktikāṃ //
61.d:
कुण्डेषु होमयेद्वह्निं समिल्लाजतिलादिभिः /
दत्वा शय्यादिकञ्चाधो दद्यादाधारशक्तिकां //
61.m: should make fire oblations in the fire-pits with sacrificial wood, puffed grain, sesame seeds, and other items; / having placed a bed and other things beneath, one should offer [worship to] the Supporting Energy.

61.s:
śākhayorvinyasenmūle devau caṇḍapracaṇdakau /
ūrdhvodumbarake devīṃ lakṣmīṃ suragaṇārcitāṃ //
61.d:
शाखयोर्विन्यसेन्मूले देवौ चण्डप्रचण्दकौ /
ऊर्ध्वोदुम्बरके देवीं लक्ष्मीं सुरगणार्चितां //
61.m: One should deposit the two gods Caṇḍa and Pracaṇḍa at the base of the doorjambs, / and on the upper lintel the goddess Lakṣmī worshipped by the hosts of gods.

61.s:
nyasyābhyarcya(3) yathānyāyaṃ śrīsūktena caturmukhaṃ /
datvā tu śrīphalādīni ācāryādestu dakṣiṇāṃ //
61.d:
न्यस्याभ्यर्च्य(3) यथान्यायं श्रीसूक्तेन चतुर्मुखं /
दत्वा तु श्रीफलादीनि आचार्यादेस्तु दक्षिणां //
61.m: Having deposited and worshipped the four-faced [lintel] according to rule with the Śrī-sūkta, / and having given bilva fruits and other gifts, along with a sacrificial fee to the ācārya and others,

61.s:
pratiṣṭhāsiddhadvārasya tvācāryaḥ sthāpayeddhariṃ /
:n
1 viṣṇurnuketi gha, ṅa, cihnitapurstakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 samidājyatilādibhiriti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 athābhyarcyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 177
prāsādādasya pratiṣṭhantu hṛtpratiṣṭheti tāṃ śṛṇu //
61.d:
प्रतिष्ठासिद्धद्वारस्य त्वाचार्यः स्थापयेद्धरिं /
:न्
1 विष्णुर्नुकेति घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुर्स्तकद्वयपाठः
2 समिदाज्यतिलादिभिरिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 अथाभ्यर्च्येति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 177
प्रासादादस्य प्रतिष्ठन्तु हृत्प्रतिष्ठेति तां शृणु //
61.m:
the ācārya should install Hari once the consecration of the doorway is accomplished.
[...]
1. "viṣṇurnuka" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked gha and ṅa.
2. "samidājyatilādibhiḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. "athābhyarcya" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
Hear now about the consecration of this temple, known as the consecration of the heart.

61.s:
samāptau śukanāśāyā(1) vedyāḥ prāgdarbhamastake /
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ kumbhamathavā śuklanirmitaṃ(2) //
61.d:
समाप्तौ शुकनाशाया(1) वेद्याः प्राग्दर्भमस्तके /
सौवर्णं राजतं कुम्भमथवा शुक्लनिर्मितं(2) //
61.m: At the completion of the vestibule, in front of the platform on the tips of darbha grass, / a pot made of gold, silver, or made of white [metal],

61.s:
aṣṭaratnauṣadhīdhātuvījalauhānvitaṃ śubhaṃ /
savastraṃ pūritaṃ cādbhirmaṇḍale cādhivāsayet //
61.d:
अष्टरत्नौषधीधातुवीजलौहान्वितं शुभं /
सवस्त्रं पूरितं चाद्भिर्मण्डले चाधिवासयेत् //
61.m: auspicious, furnished with the eight gems, medicinal herbs, minerals, seeds, and metals, / covered with cloth and filled with water, one should preliminarily consecrate on the maṇḍala.

61.s:
sapallavaṃ nṛsiṃhena hutvā sampātasañcitaṃ /
nārāyaṇākhyatattvena prāṇabhūtaṃ nyasettataḥ //
61.d:
सपल्लवं नृसिंहेन हुत्वा सम्पातसञ्चितं /
नारायणाख्यतत्त्वेन प्राणभूतं न्यसेत्ततः //
61.m: Having offered oblations with [the mantra of] Nṛsiṃha along with shoots, gathering the remnants, / one should then deposit it as the vital breath by means of the principle known as Nārāyaṇa.

61.s:
vairājabhūtāntaṃ(3) dhyāyet prāsādasya sureśvara /
tataḥ puruṣavatsarvaṃ prāsādaṃ cintayed budhaḥ //
61.d:
वैराजभूतान्तं(3) ध्यायेत् प्रासादस्य सुरेश्वर /
ततः पुरुषवत्सर्वं प्रासादं चिन्तयेद् बुधः //
61.m: O Lord of the gods, one should meditate on the temple as the limit of the universal being; / then the wise one should conceive of the entire temple as a cosmic person.

61.s:
adho datvā suvarṇaṃ tu tadvavad bhūtaṃ(4) ghaṭaṃ nyaset /
gurvādau dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād brāhmaṇādeś ca bhojanaṃ //
61.d:
अधो दत्वा सुवर्णं तु तद्ववद् भूतं(4) घटं न्यसेत् /
गुर्वादौ दक्षिणां दद्याद् ब्राह्मणादेश् च भोजनं //
61.m: Having placed gold underneath, one should deposit the jar that has become identical with that; / one should give a sacrificial fee to the guru and others, and feed the brāhmaṇas and others.

61.s:
tataḥ paścādvedibandhaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ kaṇṭhabandhanaṃ /
kaṇṭhopariṣṭāt kartavyaṃ vimalāmalasārakaṃ //
61.d:
ततः पश्चाद्वेदिबन्धं तदूर्ध्वं कण्ठबन्धनं /
कण्ठोपरिष्टात् कर्तव्यं विमलामलसारकं //
61.m: Thereafter, the binding of the platform; above that, the binding of the neck; / above the neck should be made the immaculate and pure crowning slab.

61.s:
tadūrdhvaṃ vṛkalaṃ(5) kuryāccakrañcādyaṃ sudarśanaṃ /
mūttiṃ śrīvāsudevasya grahaguptāṃ nivedayet //
61.d:
तदूर्ध्वं वृकलं(5) कुर्याच्चक्रञ्चाद्यं सुदर्शनं /
मूत्तिं श्रीवासुदेवस्य ग्रहगुप्तां निवेदयेत् //
61.m: Above that one should make the vṛkala and the primeval Sudarśana discus; / one should present the image of venerable Vāsudeva protected from planetary influences.

61.s:
kalaśaṃ vātha kurvīta tadūrdhvaṃ cakramuttamaṃ /
vedyāś ca paritaḥ sthāpyā aṣṭau vighneśvarāstvaja(6) //
:n
1 vanamālāyāmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 śuktinirmalamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ / śulvanirmitamiti
ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 vairājarūpaṃ tamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 tattvabhūtamiti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 tadūrdhvaṃ cūrṇakaṃ kuryāditi ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /
tadūrdhvaṃ culvakaṃ kuryāditi kha, gha,
cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
6 aṣṭau vedyeśvarāstvaja iti ga, gha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
:p 178
61.d:
कलशं वाथ कुर्वीत तदूर्ध्वं चक्रमुत्तमं /
वेद्याश् च परितः स्थाप्या अष्टौ विघ्नेश्वरास्त्वज(6) //
:न्
1 वनमालायामिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 शुक्तिनिर्मलमिति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः / शुल्वनिर्मितमिति
ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 वैराजरूपं तमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 तत्त्वभूतमिति घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 तदूर्ध्वं चूर्णकं कुर्यादिति ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः /
तदूर्ध्वं चुल्वकं कुर्यादिति ख, घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
6 अष्टौ वेद्येश्वरास्त्वज इति ग, घ, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
:प् 178
61.m:
Or else one should make a finial jar, and above that the supreme discus; / and around the platform, O unborn one, the eight lords of obstacles are to be installed.
[...]
1. "vanamālāyām" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. "śuktinirmalam" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and gha; "śulvanirmitam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. "vairājarūpaṃ tam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4. "tattvabhūtam" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked gha and ṅa.
5. "tadūrdhvaṃ cūrṇakaṃ kuryāt" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and ṅa.
"tadūrdhvaṃ culvakaṃ kuryāt" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and gha.
6. "aṣṭau vedyeśvarāstvaja" is the reading in the three manuscripts marked ga, gha, and ṅa.

61.s:
catvāro vā caturdikṣu sthāpanīyā garutmataḥ /
dhvajārohaṃ ca vakṣyāmi yena bhūtādi naśyati //
61.d:
चत्वारो वा चतुर्दिक्षु स्थापनीया गरुत्मतः /
ध्वजारोहं च वक्ष्यामि येन भूतादि नश्यति //
61.m: Or four [images of] Garuḍa should be installed in the four directions. / And I will explain the hoisting of the banner, by which evil spirits and the like are destroyed.

61.s:
prāsādavimbadravyāṇāṃ yāvantaḥ paramāṇavaḥ /
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi tatkartā viṣṇulokabhāk //
61.d:
प्रासादविम्बद्रव्याणां यावन्तः परमाणवः /
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि तत्कर्ता विष्णुलोकभाक् //
61.m: As many atoms as there are in the materials of the temple and the image, / for that many thousands of years its builder enjoys the world of Viṣṇu.

61.s:
kumbhāṇḍavedivimbānāṃ bhramaṇādvāyunānagha /
kaṇṭhasyāveṣṭanāj jñeyaṃ phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ dhvajāt //
61.d:
कुम्भाण्डवेदिविम्बानां भ्रमणाद्वायुनानघ /
कण्ठस्यावेष्टनाज् ज्ञेयं फलं कोटिगुणं ध्वजात् //
61.m: O sinless one, through the rotation of the pot, the dome, the altar, and the disks by the wind, / and by the encircling of the neck [of the temple], the fruit from the banner should be known to be tenfold a million.

61.s:
patākānāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi daṇḍaṃ puruṣarūpiṇaṃ /
prāsādaṃ vāsudevasya mūrtibhedaṃ(1) nibodha me //
61.d:
पताकानां प्रकृतिं विद्धि दण्डं पुरुषरूपिणं /
प्रासादं वासुदेवस्य मूर्तिभेदं(1) निबोध मे //
61.m: Know the banners to be Prakṛti, and the staff to have the form of Puruṣa; / understand from me that the temple is a manifestation of Vāsudeva's icon.

61.s:
dhāraṇāddharaṇīṃ(2) viddhi ākāśaṃ śuṣirātmakaṃ /
tejastat pāvakaṃ viddhi vāyuṃ sparśagataṃ tathā //
61.d:
धारणाद्धरणीं(2) विद्धि आकाशं शुषिरात्मकं /
तेजस्तत् पावकं विद्धि वायुं स्पर्शगतं तथा //
61.m: From holding [everything], know [it to be] the earth; space is consisting of its cavities; / know that brilliance to be fire, and air likewise abiding in touch.

61.s:
pāṣāṇādiṣveva jalaṃ pārthivaṃ pṛthivīguṇaṃ(3) /
pratiśabdodbhavaṃ śabdaṃ sparśaṃ syāt karkaśādikaṃ //
61.d:
पाषाणादिष्वेव जलं पार्थिवं पृथिवीगुणं(3) /
प्रतिशब्दोद्भवं शब्दं स्पर्शं स्यात् कर्कशादिकं //
61.m: Water [is present] verily in the stones and the like; the earthly element has the quality of earth; / sound arises from echoing; touch would be roughness and the like;

61.s:
śuklādikaṃ bhavedrūpaṃ rasamannādidarśanaṃ(4) /
dhūpādigandhaṃ gandhantu vāg bheryādiṣu saṃsthitā //
61.d:
शुक्लादिकं भवेद्रूपं रसमन्नादिदर्शनं(4) /
धूपादिगन्धं गन्धन्तु वाग् भेर्यादिषु संस्थिता //
61.m: Form would be white and other [colours]; taste is the sight of food and the like; / smell is the scent of incense and the like; and speech is situated in drums and such.

61.s:
śukanāśāśritā nāsā bāhū tadrathakau smṛtau /
śirastvaṇḍaṃ nigaditaṃ kalaśaṃ mūrdhajaṃ smṛtaṃ //
61.d:
शुकनाशाश्रिता नासा बाहू तद्रथकौ स्मृतौ /
शिरस्त्वण्डं निगदितं कलशं मूर्धजं स्मृतं //
61.m: The nose rests upon the śukanāsā; the two rathakas are remembered as the arms; / the head is declared to be the dome, and the finial is remembered as the hair on the head.

61.s:
kaṇṭhaṃ kaṇṭhamiti jñeyaṃ skandhaṃ vedī nigadyete /
pāyūpasthe praṇāle tu tvak sudhā parikīrtitā //
61.d:
कण्ठं कण्ठमिति ज्ञेयं स्कन्धं वेदी निगद्येते /
पायूपस्थे प्रणाले तु त्वक् सुधा परिकीर्तिता //
61.m: The neck should be known as the neck; the altar is declared to be the shoulders; / the anus and genitals are in the drainage channel; the plaster is proclaimed to be the skin.

61.s:
mukhaṃ dvāraṃ bhavedasya pratimā jīva ucyate /
tacchaktiṃ piṇḍikāṃ viddhi prakṛtiṃ ca tadākṛtiṃ //
:n
1 mūrtibhūtamiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 dharaṇādvāruṇīṃ viddhi iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /
dharaṇādvāruṇīṃ devīmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /
dhāraṇīṃ dharaṇīṃ viddhi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 pārthivaṃ pṛthivītalamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / pārthivaṃ
pṛthivījalamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 rasamāsthāya darśanaṃ rasamāhvādi darśanamiti kha,
cihnitapsuatakapāṭhaḥ
:p 179
61.d:
मुखं द्वारं भवेदस्य प्रतिमा जीव उच्यते /
तच्छक्तिं पिण्डिकां विद्धि प्रकृतिं च तदाकृतिं //
:न्
1 मूर्तिभूतमिति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 धरणाद्वारुणीं विद्धि इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः /
धरणाद्वारुणीं देवीमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः /
धारणीं धरणीं विद्धि इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 पार्थिवं पृथिवीतलमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / पार्थिवं
पृथिवीजलमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 रसमास्थाय दर्शनं रसमाह्वादि दर्शनमिति ख,
चिह्नितप्सुअतकपाठः
:प् 179
61.m:
Its door would be the mouth; the image is said to be the soul; / know the pedestal to be His Śakti, and its form to be Prakṛti.
[...]
1. "mūrtibhūtam" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.
2. "dharaṇādvāruṇīṃ viddhi" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
"dharaṇādvāruṇīṃ devīm" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
"dhāraṇīṃ dharaṇīṃ viddhi" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. "pārthivaṃ pṛthivītalam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / "pārthivaṃ pṛthivījalam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
4. "rasamāsthāya darśanaṃ rasamāhvādi darśanam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.

61.s:
niś calatvañca garbhosyā adhiṣṭhātā tu keśavaḥ /
evameva hariḥ sākṣātprāsādatvena saṃsthitaḥ //
61.d:
निश् चलत्वञ्च गर्भोस्या अधिष्ठाता तु केशवः /
एवमेव हरिः साक्षात्प्रासादत्वेन संस्थितः //
61.m: And unmovingness is its sanctum; its presiding deity is Keśava; / thus Hari Himself is directly present in the form of a temple.

61.s:
jaṅghā tvasya śivo jñeyaḥ skandhe dhātā vyavasthitaḥ /
ūrdhvabhāge sthito viṣṇurevaṃ tasya sthitasya hi //
61.d:
जङ्घा त्वस्य शिवो ज्ञेयः स्कन्धे धाता व्यवस्थितः /
ऊर्ध्वभागे स्थितो विष्णुरेवं तस्य स्थितस्य हि //
61.m: His shank should be known as Śiva; Dhātṛ is stationed on the shoulder; / Viṣṇu is situated in the upper portion; for of him who is situated thus,

61.s:
prāsādasya pratiṣṭhāntu dhvajarūpeṇa me śṛṇu /
dhvajaṃ kṛtvā surair daityā jitāḥ śastrādicihnitaṃ(1) //
61.d:
प्रासादस्य प्रतिष्ठान्तु ध्वजरूपेण मे शृणु /
ध्वजं कृत्वा सुरैर् दैत्या जिताः शस्त्रादिचिह्नितं(1) //
61.m: hear from me the consecration of the temple in the form of a banner. / Having made a banner marked with weapons and the like, the Daityas were conquered by the gods.

61.s:
aṇḍordhvaṃ kalaśaṃ nyasya tadūrdhvaṃ vinyaseddhvajaṃ /
vimbārdhamānaṃ daṇḍasya(2) tribhāgenātha kārayet //
61.d:
अण्डोर्ध्वं कलशं न्यस्य तदूर्ध्वं विन्यसेद्ध्वजं /
विम्बार्धमानं दण्डस्य(2) त्रिभागेनाथ कारयेत् //
61.m: Placing the pot above the dome, one should place the banner above that. / Then one should make the staff measuring half the disk, or a third [thereof].

61.s:
aṣṭāraṃ dvādaśāraṃ vā madhye mūrtimatānvitaṃ /
nārasiṃhena tārkṣyeṇa dhvajadaṇḍastu nirbraṇaḥ //
61.d:
अष्टारं द्वादशारं वा मध्ये मूर्तिमतान्वितं /
नारसिंहेन तार्क्ष्येण ध्वजदण्डस्तु निर्ब्रणः //
61.m: With eight spokes or twelve spokes, endowed in the center with an embodied form / of Nṛsiṃha [or] Garuḍa; and the banner-staff must be free from defects.

61.s:
prāsādasya tu vistāro mānaṃ daṇḍasya kīrtitaṃ /
śikharārdhena vā kuryāt tṛtīyārdhena vā punaḥ //
61.d:
प्रासादस्य तु विस्तारो मानं दण्डस्य कीर्तितं /
शिखरार्धेन वा कुर्यात् तृतीयार्धेन वा पुनः //
61.m: The breadth of the temple is proclaimed to be the measure of the staff; / or one may make it half the spire, or again half a third [of it].

61.s:
dvārasya dairghyād dviguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ vā parikalpayet /
dhvajayaṣṭirdevagṛhe aiśānyāṃ vāyavethavā //
61.d:
द्वारस्य दैर्घ्याद् द्विगुणं दण्डं वा परिकल्पयेत् /
ध्वजयष्टिर्देवगृहे ऐशान्यां वायवेथवा //
61.m: Or one should design the staff twice the length of the doorway. / The flag-pole in the god's house should be in the north-east or in the north-west.

61.s:
kṣaumādyaiś ca dhvajaṃ kuryādvicitraṃ vaikavarṇakaṃ(3) /
ghaṇṭācāmarakiṅkiṇyā bhūṣitaṃ pāpanāśanaṃ //
61.d:
क्षौमाद्यैश् च ध्वजं कुर्याद्विचित्रं वैकवर्णकं(3) /
घण्टाचामरकिङ्किण्या भूषितं पापनाशनं //
61.m: One should make the banner of linen or the like, multicolored or of a single color, / adorned with bells, chowries, and small jingling bells, destroying sins.

61.s:
daṇḍāgrāddharaṇīṃ yāvaddhastaikaṃ vistareṇa tu /
mahādhvajaḥ sarvadaḥ syātturyāṃśāddhīnatorcitaḥ //
61.d:
दण्डाग्राद्धरणीं यावद्धस्तैकं विस्तरेण तु /
महाध्वजः सर्वदः स्यात्तुर्यांशाद्धीनतोर्चितः //
61.m: Reaching from the tip of the staff to the ground, and one cubit in width: / such a great banner would bestow all [wishes]; one smaller than a fourth part is [merely] worshipped.

61.s:
dhvaje cārdhena vijñeyā patākā mānavarjitā /
vistareṇa dhvajaḥ kāryo viṃśadaṅgulasannibhaḥ //
61.d:
ध्वजे चार्धेन विज्ञेया पताका मानवर्जिता /
विस्तरेण ध्वजः कार्यो विंशदङ्गुलसन्निभः //
61.m: And the small flag should be known as half the banner, without strict measure; / the banner should be made in width measuring twenty finger-breadths.

61.s:
adhivāsavidhānena cakraṃ daṇḍaṃ dhvajaṃ tathā /
:n
1 jitāḥ śaktyādicihnitamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / jitāḥ
śakrādicihnitamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 vimbārdhamānaṃ cakrantu iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 vicitrañcaiva varṇakamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 180
devavat sakalaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍapasnapanādikaṃ //
61.d:
अधिवासविधानेन चक्रं दण्डं ध्वजं तथा /
:न्
1 जिताः शक्त्यादिचिह्नितमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / जिताः
शक्रादिचिह्नितमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 विम्बार्धमानं चक्रन्तु इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 विचित्रञ्चैव वर्णकमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 180
देववत् सकलं कृत्वा मण्डपस्नपनादिकं //
61.m:
By the rite of preliminary consecration, the wheel, staff, and banner,
[...]
1. "jitāḥ śaktyādicihnitam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / "jitāḥ śakrādicihnitam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
2. "vimbārdhamānaṃ cakrantu" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.
3. "vicitrañcaiva varṇakam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
having done everything as for a deity, [such as] the pavilion, ablution, and so on,

61.s:
netronmīlanakaṃ tyaktā pūrvoktaṃ sarvamācaret /
adhivāsayecca vidhinā śayyāyāṃ sthāpya deśikaḥ //
61.d:
नेत्रोन्मीलनकं त्यक्ता पूर्वोक्तं सर्वमाचरेत् /
अधिवासयेच्च विधिना शय्यायां स्थाप्य देशिकः //
61.m: except for the opening of the eyes, the spiritual master should perform everything previously stated / and should carry out the preliminary consecration according to rule, placing [them] on a couch.

61.s:
tataḥ sahasraśīrṣeti sūktaṃ cakre nyased budhaḥ /
tathā sudarśanaṃ mantraṃ manastattvaṃ niveśayet //
61.d:
ततः सहस्रशीर्षेति सूक्तं चक्रे न्यसेद् बुधः /
तथा सुदर्शनं मन्त्रं मनस्तत्त्वं निवेशयेत् //
61.m: Then the wise man should deposit the hymn beginning with "Sahasraśīrṣā" on the wheel; / likewise the Sudarśana mantra; and he should deposit the principle of mind.

61.s:
manorūpeṇa tasyaiva sajīvakaraṇaṃ smṛtaṃ /
areṣu mūrtayo nyasyāḥ keśavādyāḥ surottama //
61.d:
मनोरूपेण तस्यैव सजीवकरणं स्मृतं /
अरेषु मूर्तयो न्यस्याः केशवाद्याः सुरोत्तम //
61.m: The imparting of life to it is recorded [as done] in the form of mind. / O best of gods, the forms beginning with Keśava should be deposited on the spokes.

61.s:
nābhyabjapratinemīṣu nyasettattvāni deśikaḥ /
nṛsiṃhaṃ viśvarūpaṃ vā abjamadhye niveśayet //
61.d:
नाभ्यब्जप्रतिनेमीषु न्यसेत्तत्त्वानि देशिकः /
नृसिंहं विश्वरूपं वा अब्जमध्ये निवेशयेत् //
61.m: The spiritual master should deposit the principles in the lotus-hub and the rims; / he should deposit Nṛsiṃha or the Viśvarūpa form in the center of the lotus.

61.s:
sakalaṃ vinyaseddaṇḍe sūtrātmānaṃ sajīvakaṃ /
niṣkalaṃ paramātmānaṃ dhvaje dhyāyan nyaseddhariṃ //
61.d:
सकलं विन्यसेद्दण्डे सूत्रात्मानं सजीवकं /
निष्कलं परमात्मानं ध्वजे ध्यायन् न्यसेद्धरिं //
61.m: He should deposit the composite [deity] endowed with life, the Thread-soul, on the staff; / meditating on Hari, the partless Supreme Soul, he should deposit Him upon the banner.

61.s:
tacchaktiṃ vyāpinīṃ dhyāyed dhvajarūpāṃ balābalāṃ(1) /
maṇḍape(2) sthāpya cābhyarcya homaṃ kuṇḍeṣu kārayet //
61.d:
तच्छक्तिं व्यापिनीं ध्यायेद् ध्वजरूपां बलाबलां(1) /
मण्डपे(2) स्थाप्य चाभ्यर्च्य होमं कुण्डेषु कारयेत् //
61.m: He should meditate upon His all-pervading Śakti in the form of the banner, movable and unmoving. / Having installed and worshipped [them] in the pavilion, he should cause a fire oblation to be made in the fire-pits.

61.s:
kalaśe svarṇakalaśaṃ nyasya ratnāni pañca ca /
sthāpayeccakramantreṇa svarṇacakramadhastataḥ(3) //
61.d:
कलशे स्वर्णकलशं न्यस्य रत्नानि पञ्च च /
स्थापयेच्चक्रमन्त्रेण स्वर्णचक्रमधस्ततः(3) //
61.m: Placing a golden pitcher and the five gems within the finial pot, / he should install the golden wheel beneath with the wheel mantra.

61.s:
pāradena tu samplāvya netrapaṭṭena cchādayet(4) /
tato niveśayeccakraṃ tanmadhye nṛhariṃ smaret //
61.d:
पारदेन तु सम्प्लाव्य नेत्रपट्टेन च्छादयेत्(4) /
ततो निवेशयेच्चक्रं तन्मध्ये नृहरिं स्मरेत् //
61.m: Having bathed it with mercury, he should cover it with a silk cloth. / Then he should place the wheel, [and] remember Nṛhari in its center.

61.s:
oṃ kṣoṃ nṛsiṃhāya(5) namaḥ pūjayet sthāpayeddhariṃ /
tato dhvajaṃ gṛhītvā tu yajamānaḥ sabāndhavaḥ //
:n
1 calācalāmiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ, sulocanamiti ga,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 maṇḍale iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
3 svarṇacakrantu madhyata iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 netraṃ yatnena cchādayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 oṃ kṣauṃ nṛsiṃhāya nama iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 181
61.d:
ओं क्षों नृसिंहाय(5) नमः पूजयेत् स्थापयेद्धरिं /
ततो ध्वजं गृहीत्वा तु यजमानः सबान्धवः //
:न्
1 चलाचलामिति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः, सुलोचनमिति ग,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 मण्डले इति ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
3 स्वर्णचक्रन्तु मध्यत इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 नेत्रं यत्नेन च्छादयेदिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 ओं क्षौं नृसिंहाय नम इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 181
61.m:
With "oṃ kṣoṃ nṛsiṃhāya namaḥ" he should worship and install Hari. / Then, taking the banner, the patron with his relatives,
[...]
1. "calācalām" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and ṅa; "sulocanam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
2. "maṇḍale" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and ṅa.
3. "svarṇacakrantu madhyataḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4. "netraṃ yatnena cchādayet" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
5. "oṃ kṣauṃ nṛsiṃhāya namaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.

61.s:
dadhibhaktayute pātre dhvajasyāgraṃ niveśayet /
dhruvādyena phaḍantena dhvajaṃ mantreṇa pūjayet //
61.d:
दधिभक्तयुते पात्रे ध्वजस्याग्रं निवेशयेत् /
ध्रुवाद्येन फडन्तेन ध्वजं मन्त्रेण पूजयेत् //
61.m: should place the tip of the banner into a vessel containing curd and boiled rice; / he should worship the banner with the mantra beginning with Dhruva and ending with Phaṭ.

61.s:
śirasyādhāya tat pātraṃ nārāyanamanusmaran /
pradakṣiṇaṃ tu kurvīta turyamaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ //
61.d:
शिरस्याधाय तत् पात्रं नारायनमनुस्मरन् /
प्रदक्षिणं तु कुर्वीत तुर्यमङ्गलनिःस्वनैः //
61.m: Placing that vessel on his head, remembering Nārāyaṇa, / he should make a circumambulation accompanied by the auspicious sounds of musical instruments.

61.s:
tato niveśayet daṇḍaṃ mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇa tu /
muñcāmi tveti sūktena dhvajaṃ muñcedvicakṣaṇaḥ //
61.d:
ततो निवेशयेत् दण्डं मन्त्रेणाष्टाक्षरेण तु /
मुञ्चामि त्वेति सूक्तेन ध्वजं मुञ्चेद्विचक्षणः //
61.m: Then he should install the staff with the eight-syllable mantra; / the wise man should unfurl the banner with the hymn beginning with "Muñcāmi tvā".

61.s:
pātraṃ dhvajaṃ kuñjarādi dadyādācāryake dvijaḥ /
eṣa sādhāraṇaḥ prokto dhvajasyārohaṇe vidhiḥ //
61.d:
पात्रं ध्वजं कुञ्जरादि दद्यादाचार्यके द्विजः /
एष साधारणः प्रोक्तो ध्वजस्यारोहणे विधिः //
61.m: The twice-born should give the vessel, the banner, an elephant, and so forth to the preceptor. / This common rule has been declared for hoisting the banner.

61.s:
yasya devasya yaccihnaṃ tanmantreṇa sthiraṃ caret /
svargatvā dhvajadānāttu rājā balī bhavet //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye dhvajārohaṇaṃ nāma
ekaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha dviṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
lakṣmīpratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ
61.d:
यस्य देवस्य यच्चिह्नं तन्मन्त्रेण स्थिरं चरेत् /
स्वर्गत्वा ध्वजदानात्तु राजा बली भवेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये ध्वजारोहणं नाम
एकषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ द्विषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः
लक्ष्मीप्रतिष्ठाविधिः
61.m:
Whatever is the emblem of whichever deity, one should make it firm with that deity's mantra; / having gone to heaven from the gift of a banner, a king becomes mighty.
Thus ends the sixty-first chapter, named "Hoisting of the Banner", in the ancient Great Purāṇa composed by Agni.
Now, the sixty-second chapter:
The rule for the consecration of Lakṣmī.

62.s:
bhagavānuvāca
samudāyena devādeḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ pravadāmi te /
lakṣmyāḥ pratiṣṭhā prathamaṃ tathā devīgaṇasya ca //
62.d:
भगवानुवाच
समुदायेन देवादेः प्रतिष्ठां प्रवदामि ते /
लक्ष्म्याः प्रतिष्ठा प्रथमं तथा देवीगणस्य च //
62.m:
The Lord said:
I shall tell you comprehensively the consecration of the gods and other [deities]:
first, the consecration of Lakṣmī, and likewise of the group of goddesses.

62.s:
pūrvavat sakalaṃ kuryānmaṇḍapasnapanādikaṃ(1) /
bhadrapīṭhe śriyaṃ nyasya sthāpayedaṣṭa vai ghaṭān(2) //
62.d:
पूर्ववत् सकलं कुर्यान्मण्डपस्नपनादिकं(1) /
भद्रपीठे श्रियं न्यस्य स्थापयेदष्ट वै घटान्(2) //
62.m:
One should perform everything as before, the pavilion, the bathing, and the rest.
Having placed Śrī on an auspicious seat, one should indeed install eight jars.

62.s:
ghṛtenābhyajya mūlena snapayet pañcagavyakaiḥ /
hiraṇyavarṇā hariṇī netre conmīlayecchriyāḥ //
:n
1 maṇḍalasnapanādikamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 sthāpayedvaruṇe ghaṭāniti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 182
62.d:
घृतेनाभ्यज्य मूलेन स्नपयेत् पञ्चगव्यकैः /
हिरण्यवर्णा हरिणी नेत्रे चोन्मीलयेच्छ्रियाः //
:न्
1 मण्डलस्नपनादिकमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 स्थापयेद्वरुणे घटानिति घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 182
62.m:
Having anointed [her] with ghee, one should bathe [her] with the five bovine products using the root mantra.
With [the verse] 'Golden-hued, a doe...', one should open the two eyes of Śrī.
[...]
1. 'the maṇḍala, the bathing, and the rest' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. 'one should install jars for Varuṇa' is the reading of the manuscripts marked gha and ṅa.

62.s:
tanma āvaha(1) ity evaṃ pradadyānmadhuratrayam /
aśvapūrveti pūrveṇa tāṃ kumbhenābhiṣecayet(2) //
62.d:
तन्म आवह(1) इत्य् एवं प्रदद्यान्मधुरत्रयम् /
अश्वपूर्वेति पूर्वेण तां कुम्भेनाभिषेचयेत्(2) //
62.m:
With 'Bring that to me...', one should thus offer the three sweets.
With the eastern jar, [reciting] 'Preceded by horses...', one should consecrate her by aspersion.

62.s:
kāmosmiteti yāmyena paścimenābhiṣecayet /
candraṃ prabhāsāmuccāryādityavarṇeti cottarāt //
62.d:
कामोस्मितेति याम्येन पश्चिमेनाभिषेचयेत् /
चन्द्रं प्रभासामुच्चार्यादित्यवर्णेति चोत्तरात् //
62.m:
With the southern [jar, reciting] 'I am desire...', [and] one should consecrate [her] with the western [jar],
reciting 'The moon of splendid appearance...', and from the north with 'Sun-colored...'

62.s:
upaitu meti cāgneyāt kṣutpipāseti nairṛtāt /
gandhadvāreti vāyavyāṃ manasaḥ kāmamākṛtim //
62.d:
उपैतु मेति चाग्नेयात् क्षुत्पिपासेति नैरृतात् /
गन्धद्वारेति वायव्यां मनसः काममाकृतिम् //
62.m:
and from the southeast with 'May it approach me...', from the southwest with 'Hunger and thirst...',
in the northwest with 'By the fragrant doorway...', [and with] 'Desire of the mind, form...'

62.s:
īśānakalaśenaiva śiraḥ sauvarṇakardamāt /
ekāśītighaṭaiḥ snānaṃ mantreṇāpaḥ sṛjan kṣitim(3) //
62.d:
ईशानकलशेनैव शिरः सौवर्णकर्दमात् /
एकाशीतिघटैः स्नानं मन्त्रेणापः सृजन् क्षितिम्(3) //
62.m:
with the jar of the northeast upon the head, [bathing her] with golden clay.
The bath with eighty-one jars [is performed] with the mantra, releasing waters onto the earth.

62.s:
ārdrāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ gandhair ārdrāmityādipuṣpakaiḥ /
tanmayāvaha mantreṇa ya ānanda ṛcākhilaṃ(4) //
62.d:
आर्द्रां पुष्करिणीं गन्धैर् आर्द्रामित्यादिपुष्पकैः /
तन्मयावह मन्त्रेण य आनन्द ऋचाखिलं(4) //
62.m:
[Reciting] 'Moist, [standing on] a lotus pond...' with perfumes, and with flowers with 'Moist...', and the rest,
all [is offered] with the mantra 'Bring that to me...', and with the verse 'Who is bliss...'

62.s:
śāyantīyena śayyāyāṃ śrīsūktena ca sannidhim /
lakṣmīvījena cicchaktiṃ vinyasyābhyarcayet punaḥ //
62.d:
शायन्तीयेन शय्यायां श्रीसूक्तेन च सन्निधिम् /
लक्ष्मीवीजेन चिच्छक्तिं विन्यस्याभ्यर्चयेत् पुनः //
62.m:
onto the bed with the Śāyantīya [hymn], and presence [is established] with the Śrīsūkta.
Having deposited the consciousness-power with the seed-syllable of Lakṣmī, one should worship again.

62.s:
śrīsūktena maṇḍapetha kuṇḍeṣvabjāni homayet /
karavīrāṇi vā hutvā sahasraṃ śatameva vā //
62.d:
श्रीसूक्तेन मण्डपेथ कुण्डेष्वब्जानि होमयेत् /
करवीराणि वा हुत्वा सहस्रं शतमेव वा //
62.m:
Then in the pavilion, with the Śrīsūkta, one should offer lotuses into the fire-pits as fire oblations,
or having offered oleanders a thousand or a hundred [times],

62.s:
gṛhopakaraṇāntādi śrīsūktenaiva cārpayet /
tataḥ prāsādasaṃskāraṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā tu pūrvavat //
62.d:
गृहोपकरणान्तादि श्रीसूक्तेनैव चार्पयेत् /
ततः प्रासादसंस्कारं सर्वं कृत्वा तु पूर्ववत् //
62.m:
and one should present household implements, food, and the like, only with the Śrīsūkta.
Then, having performed every consecration of the temple as before,

62.s:
mantreṇa piṇḍikāṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhānaṃ tataḥ śriyaḥ(5) /
śrīsūktena ca sānnidhyaṃ pūrvavat pratyṛcaṃ japet(6) //
62.d:
मन्त्रेण पिण्डिकां कृत्वा प्रतिष्ठानं ततः श्रियः(5) /
श्रीसूक्तेन च सान्निध्यं पूर्ववत् प्रत्यृचं जपेत्(6) //
62.m:
having prepared the pedestal with the mantra, then the consecration of Śrī [is done].
And one should recite the Śrīsūkta verse by verse as before [to invoke her] presence.

62.s:
cicchaktiṃ bodhayitvā tu mālāt sānnidhyakaṃ caret /
:n
1 asminnāvaha iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 aśvamūrdheti mantreṇa tāṃ kumbhebhiniveśayediti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 mantreṇa cāsṛjat kṣitimiti kha, cihnatapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 ya ānandeti vāsasamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 mantreṇa piṇḍikāṃ kṛtvā pratimāṃ sthāpayan śriya iti ṅa,
cihntapustakapāṭhaḥ
6 pratyṛcaṃ yajediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 183
bhūsvarṇavastragonnādi(1) gurave brahmaṇerpayet /
evaṃ devyo 'khilāḥ sthāpyāvāhya svargādi bhāvayet //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye lakṣmīsthāpanaṃ nāma
dviṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha triṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
sudarśanacakrādipratiṣṭhākathanaṃ
62.d:
चिच्छक्तिं बोधयित्वा तु मालात् सान्निध्यकं चरेत् /
:न्
1 अस्मिन्नावह इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 अश्वमूर्धेति मन्त्रेण तां कुम्भेभिनिवेशयेदिति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 मन्त्रेण चासृजत् क्षितिमिति ख, चिह्नतपुस्तकपाठः
4 य आनन्देति वाससमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 मन्त्रेण पिण्डिकां कृत्वा प्रतिमां स्थापयन् श्रिय इति ङ,
चिह्न्तपुस्तकपाठः
6 प्रत्यृचं यजेदिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 183
भूस्वर्णवस्त्रगोन्नादि(1) गुरवे ब्रह्मणेर्पयेत् /
एवं देव्यो ऽखिलाः स्थाप्यावाह्य स्वर्गादि भावयेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये लक्ष्मीस्थापनं नाम
द्विषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ त्रिषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः
सुदर्शनचक्रादिप्रतिष्ठाकथनं
62.m:
Having awakened the consciousness-power, one should bring about the presence [beginning] from the garland.
[...]
1. 'bring here into this' is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
2. 'one should seat her in jars with the mantra "Whose head is a horse"' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. 'and with the mantra he released the earth' is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
4. '"Who is bliss" [for offering] clothing' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
5. 'having prepared the pedestal with the mantra, installing the image of Śrī' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
6. 'one should worship verse by verse' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
One should offer land, gold, clothing, cows, food, and the like to the guru [and] to the priest.
Thus all the goddesses should be installed; having invoked [them], one should contemplate heaven and the other realms.
Thus ends the sixty-second chapter, called 'The Installation of Lakṣmī', in the primeval Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now begins the sixty-third chapter.
Account of the Consecration of the Sudarśana Discus and Other [Deities]

63.s:
bhagavānuvāca
evaṃ tārkṣyasya cakrasya brahmaṇo nṛhares tathā /
pratiṣṭhā viṣṇuvat kāryā svasvamantreṇa tāṃ śṛṇu //
63.d:
भगवानुवाच
एवं तार्क्ष्यस्य चक्रस्य ब्रह्मणो नृहरेस् तथा /
प्रतिष्ठा विष्णुवत् कार्या स्वस्वमन्त्रेण तां शृणु //
63.m:
The Lord said:
In this manner, the consecration of Tārkṣya, the discus, Brahmā, and Nṛhari
should be performed like [that of] Viṣṇu, each with their own mantra; listen to them:

63.s:
sudarśana mahācakra śānta duṣṭabhayaṅkara /
cchinda chinda bhinda bhinda vidāraya vidāraya paramantrān grasa grasa
bhakṣaya bhakṣaya bhūtān trāyasa trāyasa hūṃ phaṭ sudarśanāya
namaḥ ||
abhyarcya cakraṃ cānena raṇe dārayete ripūn //
oṃ kṣauṃ narasiṃha ugrarūpa jvala jvala prajvala prajvala svāhā ||
63.d:
सुदर्शन महाचक्र शान्त दुष्टभयङ्कर /
च्छिन्द छिन्द भिन्द भिन्द विदारय विदारय परमन्त्रान् ग्रस ग्रस
भक्षय भक्षय भूतान् त्रायस त्रायस हूं फट् सुदर्शनाय
नमः ||
अभ्यर्च्य चक्रं चानेन रणे दारयेते रिपून् //
ओं क्षौं नरसिंह उग्ररूप ज्वल ज्वल प्रज्वल प्रज्वल स्वाहा ||
63.m:
"O Sudarśana, O great discus, peaceful one, terror to the wicked!
Cut, cut! Pierce, pierce! Tear apart, tear apart! Devour, devour the mantras of others! Consume, consume! Protect, protect against spirits! Hūṃ phaṭ, homage to Sudarśana!"
Having worshipped the discus with this [mantra], one tears apart enemies in battle.
"Oṃ kṣauṃ, O Narasiṃha of terrible form, blaze, blaze! Flurry brightly, flare brightly! Svāhā!"

63.s:
narasiṃhasya mantroyaṃ pātālākhyasya vacmi te(2) /
oṃ kṣauṃ namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya
pradīptasūryakoṭisahasrasamatejase vajranakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhāyaṃ
sphuṭavikaṭavikīrṇakesarasaṭāprakṣubhitamahārṇavāmbhodadundubhinirghoṣāya sarvamantrottāraṇāya ehyehi bhagavannarasiṃha
puruṣaparāparabrahmasatyena sphura sphura vijṛmbha vijṛmbha ākrama
garja garja muñca muñca siṃhanādān vidāraya vidāraya vidrāvaya
vidrāvaya āviśa
:n
1 bhūsvarṇagavānnādi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 pātālākhyasya vakṣyate iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 184
63.d:
नरसिंहस्य मन्त्रोयं पातालाख्यस्य वच्मि ते(2) /
ओं क्षौं नमो भगवते नरसिंहाय
प्रदीप्तसूर्यकोटिसहस्रसमतेजसे वज्रनखदंष्ट्रायुधायं
स्फुटविकटविकीर्णकेसरसटाप्रक्षुभितमहार्णवाम्भोददुन्दुभिनिर्घोषाय सर्वमन्त्रोत्तारणाय एह्येहि भगवन्नरसिंह
पुरुषपरापरब्रह्मसत्येन स्फुर स्फुर विजृम्भ विजृम्भ आक्रम
गर्ज गर्ज मुञ्च मुञ्च सिंहनादान् विदारय विदारय विद्रावय
विद्रावय आविश
:न्
1 भूस्वर्णगवान्नादि इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 पातालाख्यस्य वक्ष्यते इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 184
63.m:
This is the mantra of Narasiṃha; I shall tell you that of the one called Pātāla[-Narasiṃha]:
"Oṃ kṣauṃ, homage to the Blessed Lord Narasiṃha, who possesses brilliance equal to a thousand crores of blazing suns, whose weapons are adamantine claws and fangs, whose roar is like the kettle-drums of thunderclouds in a great ocean stirred up by the bristles of his clear, frightful, disheveled mane, who extracts all mantras! Come, come, Blessed Lord Narasiṃha! By the truth of the Puruṣa, the supreme and non-supreme Brahman, flash, flash! Expand, expand! Attack! Roar, roar! Emit, emit lion-roars! Tear apart, tear apart! Put to flight, put to flight! Enter,
[...]
1. 'land, gold, cows, food, and the like' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. 'that of the one called Pātāla will be spoken' is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.

63.s:
āviśa sarvamantrarūpāṇi sarvamantrajātayaś ca hana hana chinda
saṅkṣipa saṅkṣipa sara sara(1) dāraya dāraya sphuṭa sphuṭa
sphoṭaya sphoṭaya jvālāmālāsaṅghātamaya sarvato
'nantajvālāvajrāśanicakreṇa sarvapātālān utsādaya utsādaya sarvato
'natajvālāvajraśarapañjareṇa sarvapātālān parivāraya parivāraya
sarvapātālāsuravāsināṃ hṛdayānyākarṣaya ākarṣaya
śīghraṃ daha daha paca paca matha matha śoṣaya śoṣaya nikṛntaya
nikṛntaya tāvadyāvanme vaśamāgatāḥ pātālebhyaḥ phaṭ
asurebhyaḥ phaṭ mantrarūpebhyaḥ phaṭ mantrajātibhyaḥ phaṭ
saṃśayānmāṃ bhagavannarasiṃharūpa viṣṇo sarvāpadbhyaḥ
sarvamantrarūpebhyo rakṣa rakṣa hrūṃ phaṭ(2) namo 'stu te ||
narasiṃhasya vidyeyaṃ harirūpārthasiddhidā(3) //
63.d:
आविश सर्वमन्त्ररूपाणि सर्वमन्त्रजातयश् च हन हन छिन्द
सङ्क्षिप सङ्क्षिप सर सर(1) दारय दारय स्फुट स्फुट
स्फोटय स्फोटय ज्वालामालासङ्घातमय सर्वतो
ऽनन्तज्वालावज्राशनिचक्रेण सर्वपातालान् उत्सादय उत्सादय सर्वतो
ऽनतज्वालावज्रशरपञ्जरेण सर्वपातालान् परिवारय परिवारय
सर्वपातालासुरवासिनां हृदयान्याकर्षय आकर्षय
शीघ्रं दह दह पच पच मथ मथ शोषय शोषय निकृन्तय
निकृन्तय तावद्यावन्मे वशमागताः पातालेभ्यः फट्
असुरेभ्यः फट् मन्त्ररूपेभ्यः फट् मन्त्रजातिभ्यः फट्
संशयान्मां भगवन्नरसिंहरूप विष्णो सर्वापद्भ्यः
सर्वमन्त्ररूपेभ्यो रक्ष रक्ष ह्रूं फट्(2) नमो ऽस्तु ते ||
नरसिंहस्य विद्येयं हरिरूपार्थसिद्धिदा(3) //
63.m:
enter all mantra forms and classes of all mantras! Slay, slay! Cut! Compress, compress! Glide, glide! Tear apart, tear apart! Burst, burst! Shatter, shatter! O you who consist of a dense mass of wreaths of flames! Destroy, destroy all the subterranean regions completely with your discus of adamantine thunderbolts and endless flames! Enclose, enclose all the subterranean regions completely with your cage of adamantine arrows and endless flames! Draw out, draw out the hearts of the demons residing in all the subterranean realms! Quickly burn, burn! Cook, cook! Churn, churn! Dry up, dry up! Sever, sever until they have come under my control! Phaṭ to the subterranean realms! Phaṭ to the demons! Phaṭ to the mantra forms! Phaṭ to the classes of mantras! From doubt, O Blessed Lord in the form of Narasiṃha, O Viṣṇu, protect, protect me from all misfortunes and from all mantra forms! Hrūṃ phaṭ! Homage be to you!"
This is the spell of Narasiṃha, which takes the form of Hari and grants the attainment of one's goals.

63.s:
trilokyamohanair mantraiḥ sthāpyastrailokyamohanaḥ /
gado dakṣe śāntikaro dvibhujo vā caturbhujaḥ //
63.d:
त्रिलोक्यमोहनैर् मन्त्रैः स्थाप्यस्त्रैलोक्यमोहनः /
गदो दक्षे शान्तिकरो द्विभुजो वा चतुर्भुजः //
63.m:
